extra.en: "Denaturation is always irreversible" is wrong, and the counter-example is the one most often examined: Anfinsen showed that RNase A fully denatured with urea and β-mercaptoethanol loses all activity, yet after dialysing away the denaturants and letting the disulfides re-form under oxidising conditions, activity returns — the basis of the conclusion that primary structure determines tertiary structure.

quiz.q_zh: 硫酸铵盐析与加热沉淀，关键区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the key difference between salting out with ammonium sulfate and precipitation by heat?

options.zh: 盐析只对小分子量蛋白有效
options.en: Salting out works only on small proteins

options.zh: 盐析不破坏构象，透析后可复溶
options.en: Salting out is reversible and spares the fold

options.zh: 盐析只在 pH 等于 pI 时发生
options.en: Salting out happens only at the protein's pI

options.zh: 盐析同样会打开疏水核心
options.en: Salting out also opens the hydrophobic core

quiz.explain_zh: 盐析靠高盐夺取水化层并屏蔽表面电荷使蛋白聚集，天然构象保持完整，因此透析除盐后可恢复溶解和活性；加热则打开疏水核心造成不可逆变性。盐析在 pI 附近更容易，但并不限于该 pH，也不挑分子量。
quiz.explain_en: Salting out aggregates protein by stripping its hydration shell and screening surface charge while the native fold stays intact, so dialysis restores solubility and activity; heat instead opens the hydrophobic core irreversibly. Salting out is easier near the pI but is not restricted to that pH, and it does not depend on size.

quiz.q_zh: 蛋白变性后溶液黏度上升，最直接的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does the viscosity of a protein solution rise on denaturation?

options.zh: 伸展的肽链流体力学体积增大
options.en: Unfolded chains occupy more hydrodynamic volume

options.zh: 分子之间形成了新的共价交联
options.en: New covalent crosslinks form between molecules

options.zh: 溶液中的盐浓度随之升高
options.en: The salt concentration of the solution rises

options.zh: 肽键被水解成许多短片段
options.en: Peptide bonds are hydrolysed into short fragments

quiz.explain_zh: 紧密的球状折叠展开成无规卷曲后，同样质量占据的流体力学体积大得多，溶液流动阻力上升。变性不涉及共价键的形成或断裂——肽键完好，盐浓度也不会自行改变；肽键水解是蛋白酶降解，反而会降低黏度。
quiz.explain_en: A compact globule opening into a random coil occupies a far larger hydrodynamic volume for the same mass, so the solution resists flow more. Denaturation makes and breaks no covalent bonds — peptide bonds survive and salt concentration does not change on its own; hydrolysing peptide bonds is proteolysis, which would lower viscosity instead.

quiz.q_zh: 用 30 kDa 截留（MWCO）的超滤管浓缩一个 60 kDa 的蛋白，会发生什么？
quiz.q_en: What happens when a 60 kDa protein is concentrated in a spin concentrator with a 30 kDa MWCO?

options.zh: 蛋白透过膜，进入滤液中
options.en: The protein passes through into the filtrate

options.zh: 蛋白按电荷被吸附在膜上
options.en: The protein is adsorbed by charge on the membrane

options.zh: 蛋白在膜上被降解成片段
options.en: The protein is degraded to fragments on the membrane

options.zh: 蛋白被截留，缓冲液透过膜
options.en: The protein is held back, buffer passes through

quiz.explain_zh: MWCO 30 kDa 表示大于约 30 kDa 的分子被截留，60 kDa 的蛋白留在上室并被浓缩，水、盐和小分子随滤液透过——这也正是超滤可以同时换液的原因。超滤膜按尺寸而非电荷分离，也不会降解蛋白。
quiz.explain_en: A 30 kDa MWCO means species above roughly 30 kDa are retained, so the 60 kDa protein stays in the upper chamber and concentrates while water, salts and small molecules pass into the filtrate — which is also why ultrafiltration can exchange buffer at the same time. The membrane separates by size, not charge, and does not degrade protein.

title_zh: 双向电泳：先按电荷跑，再按分子量跑（上一讲蛋白分离的收尾）
title_en: Two-dimensional electrophoresis: charge first, then mass (closing the protein-separation review)

points.zh: 双向电泳 two-dimensional electrophoresis 是在 SEC（排阻色谱 size-exclusion chromatography）出现之前，用来从整个细胞裂解液里区分蛋白的"很古早"的方法。
points.en: Two-dimensional electrophoresis is the "very old-fashioned" way of resolving proteins out of a whole cell lysate, from before size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) existed.

points.zh: 胶跟核酸胶一样是平面胶。第一向：样品加在胶的底部，蛋白不变性，只靠蛋白表面的电荷在电场中由下往上迁移。
points.en: The gel is a flat slab like a DNA gel. First dimension: sample is loaded at the bottom, the protein is not denatured, and it migrates upward in an electric field on the strength of its surface charge alone.

points.zh: 跑到头以后蛋白"先根据电荷分开了一下"，老师也说成是按等电点 pI 分开。
points.en: By the end of that run the proteins are "separated once, by charge" — the teacher also phrases it as separation by isoelectric point (pI).

points.zh: 第二向：在 running buffer 里加 SDS 等试剂并加热，让蛋白变性，然后横向施加电压再跑一次 SDS-PAGE，按分子量分开。
points.en: Second dimension: SDS and other reagents are added to the running buffer and the sample is heated to denature the protein; a voltage is then applied at right angles for an SDS-PAGE run that separates by molecular mass.

points.zh: 老师把整个原理概括成一句话：这就是把非变性凝胶和变性凝胶结合到了一起。
points.en: The teacher sums the whole principle up in one sentence: it combines a native gel and a denaturing gel into one experiment.

points.zh: 举的例子是血红蛋白 hemoglobin 和肌红蛋白 myoglobin：长度相同、大小相同、三维结构也基本相同，分子量差距不大，单跑 SDS-PAGE 会落在同一个位置，根本分不开。
points.en: The worked example is hemoglobin versus myoglobin: same length, same size, essentially the same three-dimensional fold and little difference in mass, so on a plain SDS-PAGE they land at the same position and cannot be told apart.

points.zh: 但第一向非变性时两者电荷不同，跑到的位置不一样；第二向 SDS-PAGE 横向迁移的距离相同，纵向位置却已经分开了，于是在二维图上成为两个点。
points.en: In the native first dimension, though, their charges differ so they stop at different heights; in the SDS-PAGE second dimension they migrate the same horizontal distance but from different starting heights, so they end up as two separate spots.

points.zh: 老师自述只在课本上学过、从没亲手做过，认为很不好操作，而且现在有了 SEC，这个方法"基本上没有用处了"。
points.en: The teacher says he only ever learned this from a textbook and has never run it, finds it awkward to perform, and considers it "basically useless now" given SEC.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 第一向严格来说不是"单纯靠表面电荷往上跑"，而是等电聚焦 IEF（isoelectric focusing）：在固定 pH 梯度胶条 IPG strip 上，蛋白迁移到 pH 等于自身 pI 的位置，此处净电荷为零就停下来，是一个聚焦而不是持续迁移的过程。第一向分辨的只是 pI，与分子大小无关；课上"血红蛋白体积比较大所以跑得慢一点"把大小因素混了进来。
extra.en: Strictly, the first dimension is not "migration driven by surface charge" but isoelectric focusing (IEF): on an immobilised pH gradient (IPG) strip each protein migrates until the pH equals its own pI, where its net charge is zero and it stops. It is a focusing process, not continuous migration, and it resolves pI only — size plays no part. The lecture's remark that "hemoglobin is bigger so it runs a bit slower" mixes size back in.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 取代双向电泳的并不是 SEC，而是 LC-MS/MS 的鸟枪法蛋白质组学 shotgun proteomics。SEC 只按流体力学半径分离，峰容量很低，根本不足以拆开一个完整的细胞裂解液；双向电泳被淘汰是因为质谱能直接鉴定肽段序列，而不是因为色谱能替代它的分辨率。
extra.en: What replaced 2-DE was not SEC but LC-MS/MS shotgun proteomics. SEC separates only by hydrodynamic radius and has far too little peak capacity to resolve a whole lysate; 2-DE fell out of use because mass spectrometry identifies peptide sequences directly, not because a chromatography column matched its resolving power.

extra.zh: 天然血红蛋白是 α₂β₂ 四聚体，约 64 kDa；肌红蛋白是单体，约 17 kDa，两者整体分子量差约四倍。课上说的"大小相同"只在亚基层面成立：α 链 141 个残基、β 链 146 个残基、肌红蛋白 153 个残基。而 SDS-PAGE 本来就把四聚体拆成亚基，所以在亚基层面这个例子是站得住的。
extra.en: Native hemoglobin is an α₂β₂ tetramer of about 64 kDa; myoglobin is a ~17 kDa monomer, a roughly fourfold difference in intact mass. The lecture's "same size" holds only at the subunit level: the α chain is 141 residues, β is 146, myoglobin 153. Since SDS-PAGE dissociates the tetramer into subunits anyway, the example does work at that level.

extra.zh: 常规双向电泳用 pH 3–10 的宽范围 IPG 胶条，一块胶可以显示上千个蛋白点；换成 pH 范围只有一两个单位的窄范围胶条时，可以分开 pI 只相差百分之几个 pH 单位的蛋白异构体（例如磷酸化前后的同一蛋白）。
extra.en: A routine 2-DE run uses a broad pH 3–10 IPG strip and can display on the order of a thousand spots; with a narrow-range strip spanning only one or two pH units it resolves protein isoforms whose pI values differ by a few hundredths of a pH unit — for example the same protein before and after phosphorylation.

quiz.q_zh: 双向电泳的第一向依据什么性质分离蛋白？
quiz.q_en: On what property does the first dimension of 2-DE separate proteins?

options.zh: 亚基数目
options.en: Number of subunits

options.zh: 分子量 Mr
options.en: Molecular mass

options.zh: 疏水性
options.en: Hydrophobicity

options.zh: 等电点 pI
options.en: Isoelectric point pI

quiz.explain_zh: 第一向是等电聚焦，蛋白在 pH 梯度中迁移到净电荷为零的位置停下，分开的是等电点。分子量要等到第二向 SDS-PAGE 才被分开；疏水性是反相色谱的分离依据；亚基数目在变性条件下已经不存在了。
quiz.explain_en: The first dimension is isoelectric focusing: each protein migrates through a pH gradient until its net charge is zero, so pI is what is resolved. Molecular mass is only separated in the SDS-PAGE second dimension, hydrophobicity is what reversed-phase chromatography sorts on, and subunit number no longer exists once the sample is denatured.

quiz.q_zh: 在跑第二向之前，样品要经过什么处理？
quiz.q_en: How is the sample treated before the second dimension is run?

options.zh: 除去 SDS 使蛋白重新折叠
options.en: Remove SDS so it can refold

options.zh: 加两性电解质建立 pH 梯度
options.en: Add ampholytes to set a pH gradient

options.zh: 加蔗糖以增大样品的密度
options.en: Add sucrose to raise sample density

options.zh: 加 SDS 并加热使蛋白变性
options.en: Add SDS and heat to denature it

quiz.explain_zh: 第二向是 SDS-PAGE，必须先加 SDS 并加热让蛋白变性、带上与长度成正比的负电荷，才能按分子量分离。加两性电解质是建立第一向 pH 梯度的做法，加蔗糖只是普通上样缓冲液增重的成分，去除 SDS 让蛋白复性则会毁掉第二向的分离依据。
quiz.explain_en: The second dimension is SDS-PAGE, so the sample must first be given SDS and heated: only a denatured chain coated in charge proportional to its length separates by mass. Ampholytes are what build the first-dimension pH gradient, sucrose is just a loading-buffer densifier, and stripping SDS to let the protein refold would destroy the basis of the second separation.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么血红蛋白亚基和肌红蛋白单跑 SDS-PAGE 很难分开？
quiz.q_en: Why are hemoglobin subunits and myoglobin hard to separate on SDS-PAGE alone?

options.zh: 两者的等电点完全相同
options.en: Their isoelectric points are identical

options.zh: 两者都不能与 SDS 结合
options.en: Neither of them can bind SDS

options.zh: 两者都会被 SDS 直接降解
options.en: Both are degraded outright by SDS

options.zh: 两者的亚基分子量非常接近
options.en: Their subunit masses are very close

quiz.explain_zh: SDS-PAGE 只按分子量分离，而 Hb 的 α 链 141 个残基、β 链 146 个残基与 Mb 的 153 个残基长度相近，条带重叠。它们的等电点并不相同，正因为不同，第一向等电聚焦才能把它们分开；SDS 是变性剂而非蛋白酶，也不存在"不结合 SDS"的问题。
quiz.explain_en: SDS-PAGE sorts by mass only, and the 141-residue α chain, 146-residue β chain and 153-residue myoglobin are close enough in length that the bands overlap. Their pI values are not identical — that difference is exactly what lets the IEF first dimension separate them — and SDS is a denaturant, not a protease, so neither failing to bind it nor being degraded by it applies.

title_zh: 从蛋白定量转入酶学：本章计划与布赫纳的无细胞发酵
title_en: From protein assays into enzymology: the chapter plan and Buchner's cell-free fermentation

points.zh: 蛋白含量测定的老方法（凯氏定氮 Kjeldahl、双缩脲 biuret）前面已经提过，而且现在都用 NanoDrop，所以不再细讲，直接进入酶通论。
points.en: The classical protein-quantification methods (Kjeldahl nitrogen, the biuret assay) were already covered and everyone now uses a NanoDrop, so they are skipped and the class moves straight into general enzymology.

points.zh: 本讲的目标：把米氏方程 Michaelis-Menten equation 的推导完整讲一遍——每一步是怎么推的、为什么会推成那个样子。
points.en: The goal of this session: work through the derivation of the Michaelis-Menten equation in full — each step, and why it comes out the way it does.

points.zh: 还会尽量讲到抑制剂：竞争性抑制 competitive inhibition 和非竞争性抑制 non-competitive inhibition。
points.en: Inhibitors are to be covered as far as time allows: competitive inhibition and non-competitive inhibition.

points.zh: 老师提醒这一章涉及较多数学和化学概念，需要慢慢理解；并说如果要做 RdRp（RNA 依赖的 RNA 聚合酶），酶活测定与之后的实验会非常相关，所以要讲细。
points.en: The teacher warns this chapter carries more mathematics and chemistry than the others and needs to be taken slowly; he adds that if the student works on RdRp (RNA-dependent RNA polymerase), enzyme-activity measurement will bear directly on the experiments to come, so it is worth doing thoroughly.

points.zh: 课本为什么强调酶的发现史：因为酶的发现史基本上与整个生物化学的发展史是平行的，可以用几个诺贝尔奖节点串起来。
points.en: Why the textbook stresses the history of enzyme discovery: it runs essentially parallel to the history of biochemistry as a whole, and can be strung together from a handful of Nobel Prize milestones.

points.zh: 第一个节点是布赫纳 Buchner（课上说"87年"）：他发现不含细胞的、压碎的酵母汁也能实现发酵。
points.en: The first milestone is Buchner (the lecture says "'87"): he showed that a cell-free pressed juice of yeast can still carry out fermentation.

points.zh: 由此他首次提出，发酵这个过程实际上不需要活的细胞就可以进行，是活细胞里的某些物质在起作用。
points.en: From this he first proposed that fermentation does not in fact require living cells: some substance present inside the living cell is what does the work.

points.zh: 他当时给这种物质起的名字叫"酵素"。老师吐槽现在的广告又把这个 1900 年前后的旧概念拿出来卖，属于挂羊头卖狗肉。
points.en: He named that substance "jiaosu" (zymase / "ferment"). The teacher's aside: today's advertising has dug this turn-of-the-century term back out to sell products, which he calls selling dog meat under a sheep's-head sign.

extra.zh: 年份要说清：布赫纳的无细胞发酵实验发表于 1897 年（课上的"87年"指 1897 年，不是 1887 年），他因此获得的是 1907 年诺贝尔化学奖。课上后面提到的"1900 年"也应理解为这个世纪之交的大致时间。
extra.en: Fix the dates: Buchner's cell-free fermentation experiment was published in 1897 (the lecture's "'87" means 1897, not 1887), and the Nobel Prize in Chemistry it earned him came in 1907. The "1900" mentioned later should likewise be read as "around the turn of that century".

extra.zh: "酶 enzyme"这个词是 Wilhelm Kühne 在 19 世纪 70 年代末提出的，希腊文字面意思是"在酵母之中 in yeast"，用来区分"活细胞内的"与"离开细胞仍起作用的"催化物质。布赫纳汁液里起作用的成分被命名为 zymase（酿酶），后来证明它不是单一物质，而是糖酵解全套酶的混合物。
extra.en: The word "enzyme" was coined by Wilhelm Kühne in the late 1870s, literally "in yeast" in Greek, to distinguish catalytic activity inside living cells from activity that survives outside them. The active principle of Buchner's juice was named zymase, and was later shown not to be a single substance at all but the whole complement of glycolytic enzymes.

extra.zh: 凯氏定氮法测的是总氮，按蛋白质平均含氮量约 16% 换算，系数为 100/16 = 6.25；含氮量偏离平均值的蛋白会有系统偏差，非蛋白氮也会被算进去。NanoDrop 的 A280 则依赖 Trp、Tyr（以及胱氨酸二硫键）的吸收，不含芳香族氨基酸的蛋白无法用 A280 定量，必须改用 BCA 或 Bradford。
extra.en: Kjeldahl measures total nitrogen and converts it with the factor 100/16 = 6.25, from an assumed average nitrogen content of about 16% in protein; proteins departing from that average give a systematic error, and non-protein nitrogen is counted too. NanoDrop A280 instead depends on absorbance by Trp, Tyr and (weakly) cystine disulfides, so a protein with no aromatic residues cannot be quantified this way and needs BCA or Bradford.

extra.zh: 市售保健品"酵素"多是果蔬发酵液，主要成分是有机酸、糖和微生物代谢物。即使其中确实含有酶，口服后蛋白质类的酶也会在胃酸和胃蛋白酶作用下变性降解，与生物化学意义上"具有催化活性的生物大分子"不是一回事。
extra.en: The commercial health product sold as "jiaosu" is usually a fermented fruit-and-vegetable liquid whose main constituents are organic acids, sugars and microbial metabolites. Even where enzymes are genuinely present, a protein enzyme taken orally is denatured and digested by stomach acid and pepsin — it is not the same thing as an enzyme in the biochemical sense.

quiz.q_zh: 布赫纳的无细胞发酵实验最直接说明了什么？
quiz.q_en: What did Buchner's cell-free fermentation experiment most directly show?

options.zh: 发酵必须有活酵母细胞
options.en: Fermentation does require living yeast cells

options.zh: 发酵产物是乳酸而非乙醇
options.en: Fermentation gives lactate rather than ethanol

options.zh: 发酵过程不消耗任何底物
options.en: Fermentation consumes no substrate at all

options.zh: 发酵不需要活细胞参与
options.en: Fermentation does not require living cells

quiz.explain_zh: 压碎的酵母汁里没有完整的活细胞，却仍然能把糖发酵，说明起催化作用的是细胞内的可提取物质，发酵不是"活力"的属性。产物是乙醇和 CO₂，底物是糖，都被消耗，这两项与实验结论无关。
quiz.explain_en: The pressed yeast juice contains no intact living cells yet still ferments sugar, so the catalytic agent is an extractable substance from inside the cell and fermentation is not a property of "vital force". The products are ethanol and CO₂ and the sugar substrate is consumed, so neither of those statements bears on the conclusion.

quiz.q_zh: 用 NanoDrop 的 A280 测蛋白浓度，吸收主要来自哪两种残基？
quiz.q_en: In NanoDrop A280 protein quantification, which two residues provide most of the absorbance?

options.zh: Trp 和 Tyr
options.en: Trp and Tyr

options.zh: Ser 和 Thr
options.en: Ser and Thr

options.zh: Gly 和 Ala
options.en: Gly and Ala

options.zh: Lys 和 Arg
options.en: Lys and Arg

quiz.explain_zh: 280 nm 的吸收来自芳香族侧链，主要是色氨酸 Trp，其次是酪氨酸 Tyr，胱氨酸的二硫键有很弱的贡献。碱性残基、羟基残基和小侧链残基在这个波长都没有吸收，所以完全不含芳香族氨基酸的蛋白测不出来。
quiz.explain_en: Absorbance at 280 nm comes from aromatic side chains — mainly tryptophan, then tyrosine, with a weak contribution from cystine disulfides. Basic residues, hydroxyl-bearing residues and small side chains absorb nothing at this wavelength, which is why a protein wholly lacking aromatics cannot be read this way.

quiz.q_zh: 凯氏定氮法把测得的总氮换算成蛋白量，用的系数约为多少？
quiz.q_en: Roughly what factor converts Kjeldahl total nitrogen into protein mass?
quiz.explain_zh: 蛋白质平均含氮约 16%，因此 100/16 ≈ 6.25，总氮乘以 6.25 即得蛋白量。这只是一个平均系数，实际含氮量偏高或偏低的蛋白会带来系统偏差，样品中的非蛋白氮也会被一并计入。
quiz.explain_en: Protein averages about 16% nitrogen, so 100/16 ≈ 6.25 and total nitrogen times 6.25 gives protein mass. It is only an average: proteins whose nitrogen content departs from 16% give a systematic error, and any non-protein nitrogen in the sample is counted as protein too.

title_zh: 脲酶结晶到核酶：1946、1989、1997 三个酶学诺奖
title_en: From crystalline urease to ribozymes: the 1946, 1989 and 1997 enzyme Nobels

points.zh: 距布赫纳大约五十年后，Sumner 从刀豆 jack bean 种子里分离出脲酶 urease，并证明这种具有催化活性的东西是一种蛋白质。
points.en: About fifty years after Buchner, Sumner isolated urease from jack bean seeds and proved that this catalytically active material is a protein.

points.zh: 另一位研究者（Northrop）把蛋白酶做成了结晶，是比较早得到酶的蛋白结晶的人。
points.en: Another worker (Northrop) crystallised proteases, among the first to obtain an enzyme as a protein crystal.

points.zh: 两项工作合起来就证明了：有些蛋白质能够结晶，有些蛋白质可以发挥催化活性——酶就是蛋白质。两人因此共同获得 1946 年诺贝尔奖。
points.en: Put together, the two lines of work establish that some proteins can be crystallised and some proteins exert catalytic activity — enzymes are proteins. The pair shared the 1946 Nobel Prize.

points.zh: 1989 年的诺奖给了核酶 ribozyme 的发现。老师说自己当年学生化时对核酶的概念一直不太清楚。
points.en: The 1989 Nobel went to the discovery of the ribozyme. The teacher admits the concept never became clear to him when he first studied biochemistry.

points.zh: 核酶本质上就是一段 RNA，它就是一种 RNA。
points.en: A ribozyme is, in essence, simply a piece of RNA — it is RNA and nothing else.

points.zh: 神奇之处在于这种 RNA 具有催化能力：它可以催化水解，也可以像 DNA 聚合酶那样催化核酸的连接。
points.en: What makes it remarkable is that this RNA is catalytic: it can catalyse hydrolysis, and it can catalyse the joining of nucleic acids much as a DNA polymerase does.

points.zh: 老师强调另一点"神奇"：核酶有酶的功能，但它本身仍然会被 RNA 酶 RNase 降解。
points.en: A second point the teacher stresses as remarkable: a ribozyme has enzyme function yet is itself still degraded by RNase.

points.zh: 最后一个节点是 1997 年的 ATP 合成酶 ATP synthase，老师称之为酶学里边里程碑式的一个奖。这段通史"不算重点"，有印象即可。
points.en: The last milestone is ATP synthase in 1997, which the teacher calls a landmark award in enzymology. This whole historical stretch, he says, is "not really a focus" — a general impression is enough.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 1989 年是 Thomas Cech 与 Sidney Altman 获诺贝尔化学奖的年份，不是核酶被发现的年份。发现本身在 1982 年（Cech，四膜虫 Tetrahymena I 型内含子的自剪接 self-splicing）和 1983 年（Altman，RNase P 的催化活性来自它的 RNA 亚基而非蛋白亚基）。
extra.en: 1989 is the year Thomas Cech and Sidney Altman received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, not the year ribozymes were discovered. The discoveries themselves came in 1982 (Cech: self-splicing of the Tetrahymena group I intron) and 1983 (Altman: the catalytic activity of RNase P resides in its RNA subunit, not its protein subunit).

extra.zh: 最重要的核酶其实在每个细胞里天天工作：核糖体的肽基转移酶中心 peptidyl transferase center 完全由 23S rRNA（原核）/28S rRNA（真核）构成，活性中心附近没有蛋白质侧链参与催化。也就是说肽键是由 RNA 催化生成的，这是支持 RNA world 假说最有力的结构证据之一。
extra.en: The most important ribozyme is at work in every cell every day: the peptidyl transferase centre of the ribosome is built entirely from 23S rRNA (prokaryotes) / 28S rRNA (eukaryotes), with no protein side chain within reach of the catalytic site. Peptide bonds are therefore made by RNA catalysis — one of the strongest structural arguments for the RNA world hypothesis.

extra.zh: 把获奖人补全：1946 年诺贝尔化学奖由 Sumner（脲酶结晶，证明酶是蛋白质）、Northrop 和 Stanley 三人分享，后两位因制备了酶和病毒蛋白的纯结晶。1997 年化学奖由 Boyer 与 Walker（ATP 合成酶的结合变化机制 binding change mechanism 与晶体结构）以及 Skou（Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase 的发现）分享。
extra.en: Completing the laureate lists: the 1946 Chemistry Nobel was shared by Sumner (crystalline urease, proving enzymes are proteins) with Northrop and Stanley, the latter two for preparing pure crystals of enzymes and of virus proteins. The 1997 Chemistry Nobel was shared by Boyer and Walker (the binding-change mechanism and crystal structure of ATP synthase) with Skou (discovery of the Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase).

extra.zh: 三个名字不要混：核酶 ribozyme 是有催化活性的 RNA；核糖核酸酶 RNase 是水解 RNA 的（通常是蛋白质）酶；脱氧核酶 DNAzyme 是人工体外筛选得到的催化性 DNA，自然界中尚未发现。此外核酶多数是分子内反应、只作用一次，严格说属于"单周转"，与真正多周转的酶不完全一样。
extra.en: Keep three names apart: a ribozyme is catalytic RNA; an RNase is an enzyme (usually a protein) that hydrolyses RNA; a DNAzyme is catalytic DNA obtained by in vitro selection and has not been found in nature. Note too that many natural ribozymes act intramolecularly and only once — single-turnover — which is not quite the multiple-turnover behaviour of a true enzyme.

quiz.q_zh: 核酶 ribozyme 的化学本质是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is a ribozyme, chemically?

options.zh: 结合 RNA 的蛋白质
options.en: A protein that binds to RNA

options.zh: 携带氨基酸的 tRNA
options.en: A tRNA carrying an amino acid

options.zh: 具有催化活性的 RNA
options.en: RNA with catalytic activity

options.zh: 水解 RNA 的蛋白质
options.en: A protein that hydrolyses RNA

quiz.explain_zh: 核酶就是一段本身具有催化能力的 RNA，可以催化水解或核酸的连接。水解 RNA 的是核糖核酸酶 RNase，属于蛋白质；单纯结合 RNA 的蛋白是 RNA 结合蛋白，没有催化功能；携带氨基酸的 tRNA 是氨酰-tRNA，是翻译的底物而不是催化剂。
quiz.explain_en: A ribozyme is a stretch of RNA that is itself catalytic, able to carry out hydrolysis or the joining of nucleic acids. RNA-hydrolysing activity belongs to RNase, which is a protein; a protein that merely binds RNA is an RNA-binding protein with no catalytic role; and a tRNA bearing an amino acid is an aminoacyl-tRNA, a substrate of translation rather than a catalyst.

quiz.q_zh: Sumner 与 Northrop 的工作合在一起证明了什么？
quiz.q_en: Taken together, what did the work of Sumner and Northrop establish?

options.zh: 所有的酶都必须含金属辅因子
options.en: All enzymes must contain a metal cofactor

options.zh: 某些蛋白质可结晶且有催化活性
options.en: Some proteins crystallize and are catalytic

options.zh: 酶在反应过程中被永久消耗掉
options.en: Enzymes are permanently consumed by reaction

options.zh: 酶能够改变反应的平衡位置
options.en: Enzymes can shift the position of equilibrium

quiz.explain_zh: Sumner 证明有催化活性的脲酶是蛋白质，Northrop 得到了蛋白酶的结晶，两者合起来把"酶"和"蛋白质"这两个范畴对应了起来。金属辅因子只是部分酶需要；酶作为催化剂不被消耗；改变平衡位置恰恰是酶做不到的事。
quiz.explain_en: Sumner showed that catalytically active urease is a protein and Northrop crystallised proteases; together they identified the category "enzyme" with the category "protein". Metal cofactors are required only by some enzymes, a catalyst is by definition not consumed, and shifting the equilibrium is precisely what an enzyme cannot do.

quiz.q_zh: 核糖体上催化肽键形成的肽基转移酶中心由什么构成？
quiz.q_en: What builds the peptidyl transferase centre that forms peptide bonds on the ribosome?

options.zh: 延伸因子 EF-Tu
options.en: Elongation factor EF-Tu

options.zh: 23S rRNA
options.en: The 23S rRNA

options.zh: 核糖体蛋白 L2
options.en: The ribosomal protein L2

options.zh: tRNA 的受体臂
options.en: The tRNA acceptor arm

quiz.explain_zh: 晶体结构显示肽基转移酶中心完全由 23S rRNA（真核为 28S rRNA）构成，最近的蛋白质侧链离活性位点还有相当距离，因此核糖体本身就是一个核酶。核糖体蛋白起结构支撑作用，受体臂是携带氨基酸的底物端，EF-Tu 只负责把氨酰-tRNA 递送到 A 位。
quiz.explain_en: Crystal structures show the peptidyl transferase centre is made entirely of 23S rRNA (28S in eukaryotes), with the nearest protein side chain well away from the active site — the ribosome is itself a ribozyme. Ribosomal proteins provide structural scaffolding, the acceptor arm is the substrate end that carries the amino acid, and EF-Tu only delivers aminoacyl-tRNA to the A site.

title_zh: 酶的基本特点：不改变平衡、只加快速度，效率高、专一性强
title_en: What enzymes do: no shift in equilibrium, only faster rates, huge efficiency, strict specificity

points.zh: 整个酶这一章始终围绕酶的几个特点展开；老师在幻灯上把 enzyme 简写成 ENC。
points.en: The whole enzyme chapter is organised around a handful of enzyme properties; the teacher abbreviates "enzyme" as ENC on his slide.

points.zh: 第一个特点：酶跟催化剂类似，一定不会改变反应的平衡。A 到 B，不加酶时 30% 的 A 转化成 B，加了酶还是 30%。
points.en: First property: like any catalyst, an enzyme never changes the equilibrium of a reaction. For A going to B, if 30% of A converts to B without enzyme, it is still 30% with enzyme.

points.zh: 这是一个很常见的感性误区：很多人以为加了酶就能从 30% 变成 100% 全部转化成 B，实际上不是。
points.en: This is a common intuitive error: people imagine that adding enzyme takes the conversion from 30% to 100%, all of A becoming B. It does not.

points.zh: 酶改变的是速度：A 到 B 本来需要两天才达到 30%，加酶以后可能两分钟就达到同样的 30%。
points.en: What the enzyme changes is rate: a conversion that took two days to reach 30% may take two minutes to reach the same 30% once enzyme is added.

points.zh: 要真正改变平衡，只能改变底物或反应条件——比如提高 A 的含量（改的是底物，不是催化剂），或者把温度从 30 ℃ 提升到 60 ℃。
points.en: To genuinely change the equilibrium you must change the substrate or the reaction conditions — raise the concentration of A (that is changing the substrate, not the catalyst), or take the temperature from 30 °C up to 60 °C.

points.zh: 这个概念在整个生化里很重要，后面会频繁提到，特别是糖酵解 glycolysis 那一章：那一章通篇讲什么抑制、什么促进这个反应。
points.en: The concept matters throughout biochemistry and recurs constantly, above all in the glycolysis chapter, which is entirely about what inhibits and what promotes each reaction.

points.zh: 但糖酵解那一章唯独不会说"某个酶去促进/抑制这个反应"，只会说某个产物促进这个过程、某个底物抑制这个过程。
points.en: Yet that chapter never says "this enzyme promotes or inhibits the reaction"; it says a particular product promotes the process or a particular substrate inhibits it.

points.zh: 第二、第三个特点：酶的催化效率远高于铁、铂这类非生物金属催化剂，高出一千倍甚至一万倍；而且酶有高度的专一性，只能催化特定的反应——效率高是优点，专一性高则既是优点也是限制。
points.en: Second and third properties: enzymes catalyse far more efficiently than non-biological metal catalysts such as iron or platinum, by a thousand- to ten-thousand-fold; and they are highly specific, catalysing only one particular reaction — the efficiency is an advantage, the specificity both an advantage and a constraint.

extra.zh: 机理上的原因值得记住：酶只降低活化能 Ea（通过稳定过渡态），而正反应和逆反应经过的是同一个过渡态，所以 k₊ 和 k₋ 提高相同的倍数，K_eq = k₊/k₋ 保持不变，ΔG°′ 也不变。一句话：酶改变反应的动力学，不改变热力学。
extra.en: The mechanistic reason is worth memorising: an enzyme only lowers the activation energy Ea, by stabilising the transition state, and the forward and reverse reactions pass through that same transition state. So k₊ and k₋ are raised by identical factors, K_eq = k₊/k₋ is unchanged, and ΔG°′ is unchanged. In one line: enzymes alter the kinetics, never the thermodynamics.

extra.zh: "一千到一万倍"是相对于金属催化剂的比较。若与完全不加催化剂的反应相比，酶的速率提高要大得多：常见范围是 10⁵–10¹⁷ 倍，其中乳清苷酸脱羧酶 OMP decarboxylase 约 10¹⁷ 倍——同一反应在没有酶时的半衰期以千万年计。
extra.en: The "thousand- to ten-thousand-fold" figure is the comparison against metal catalysts. Measured against the completely uncatalysed reaction, enzymatic rate enhancements are far larger — typically 10⁵ to 10¹⁷, with OMP decarboxylase at roughly 10¹⁷, a reaction whose uncatalysed half-life runs to tens of millions of years.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: "把温度从 30 ℃ 提到 60 ℃ 就改变平衡"需要限定：按 van 't Hoff 关系，只有当反应的 ΔH ≠ 0 时，温度才会移动 K_eq；ΔH ≈ 0 的反应升温不改变平衡常数。而且对大多数酶来说，60 ℃ 首先发生的是变性失活，观察到的"变化"往往是酶没了，而不是平衡移动了。
extra.en: "Going from 30 °C to 60 °C changes the equilibrium" needs a qualifier: by the van 't Hoff relation, temperature shifts K_eq only when ΔH ≠ 0; for a reaction with ΔH ≈ 0 heating leaves the equilibrium constant alone. And for most enzymes the first thing 60 °C does is denature them, so what you observe is usually the loss of the enzyme rather than a shifted equilibrium.

extra.zh: "专一性"要分层次记：键专一性（酯酶水解各种酯键）、基团专一性（胰蛋白酶只切 Lys/Arg 之后的肽键）、绝对专一性（脲酶只作用于尿素）、立体专一性（只识别 L-氨基酸或 D-糖，例如乳酸脱氢酶只产生 L-乳酸）。考试最常考的是立体专一性和绝对专一性的例子。
extra.en: Specificity comes in tiers worth separating: bond specificity (esterases hydrolyse esters generally), group specificity (trypsin cuts only after Lys or Arg), absolute specificity (urease acts on urea alone), and stereospecificity (recognising only L-amino acids or D-sugars — lactate dehydrogenase makes only L-lactate). Exams most often ask for examples of stereospecificity and absolute specificity.

quiz.q_zh: 向一个反应体系中加入酶，会发生什么？
quiz.q_en: What happens when enzyme is added to a reaction system?

options.zh: 更快到达同一个平衡点
options.en: The same equilibrium is reached faster

options.zh: 平衡向底物方向明显移动
options.en: The equilibrium shifts toward substrate

options.zh: 平衡常数 Keq 随之增大
options.en: The equilibrium constant Keq increases

options.zh: 平衡向产物方向明显移动
options.en: The equilibrium shifts toward product

quiz.explain_zh: 酶是催化剂，只加快到达平衡的速度而不改变平衡的位置。课上的数字很好记：不加酶两天转化 30%，加酶后两分钟仍然是 30%。平衡向任一方向移动或 Keq 发生变化，都要求改变浓度或反应条件，不是加催化剂能做到的。
quiz.explain_en: An enzyme is a catalyst: it shortens the time needed to reach equilibrium without moving where that equilibrium lies. The lecture's numbers make it memorable — two days for 30% conversion without enzyme, two minutes for the same 30% with it. Shifting the balance either way, or changing Keq, requires altered concentrations or conditions, not a catalyst.

quiz.q_zh: 酶不能改变平衡常数，根本原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the fundamental reason an enzyme cannot change the equilibrium constant?

options.zh: 它只结合底物而不结合产物
options.en: It binds the substrate but never product

options.zh: 它在反应过程中被消耗掉了
options.en: It is used up during the reaction itself

options.zh: 它降低了产物一侧的自由能
options.en: It lowers the free energy on the product side

options.zh: 它同等地加快正反应和逆反应
options.en: It speeds the forward and reverse equally

quiz.explain_zh: 酶降低的是同一个过渡态的活化能，正逆反应都经过这个过渡态，k₊ 与 k₋ 被提高相同倍数，比值 Keq 因此不变。酶同样能结合产物（这正是逆反应能被催化的原因），酶作为催化剂不被消耗，也不改变底物与产物之间的自由能差 ΔG°′。
quiz.explain_en: The enzyme lowers the activation energy of a single transition state through which both directions pass, so k₊ and k₋ rise by the same factor and their ratio Keq is untouched. Enzymes do bind product — that is why the reverse reaction is catalysed too — a catalyst is not consumed, and the free-energy difference ΔG°′ between substrate and product is left alone.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项能真正改变反应达到的平衡位置？
quiz.q_en: Which of these genuinely changes where the reaction's equilibrium lies?

options.zh: 换用一种更高效的酶
options.en: Switching to a more efficient enzyme

options.zh: 提高底物 A 的起始浓度
options.en: Raising the substrate A concentration

options.zh: 把反应时间延长一倍
options.en: Letting the reaction run twice as long

options.zh: 提高体系中酶的浓度
options.en: Raising the enzyme concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 平衡位置由反应物与产物的浓度以及反应条件决定，按质量作用定律提高底物浓度会把反应推向产物一侧。加酶、换更高效的酶只影响到达平衡的速度，延长时间也只是让体系更接近同一个平衡，三者都不移动平衡本身。
quiz.explain_en: Where the equilibrium sits is set by reactant and product concentrations and by the reaction conditions; by mass action, more substrate pushes the reaction toward product. Adding enzyme or using a better enzyme only affects how fast equilibrium is reached, and more time merely brings the system closer to that same equilibrium.

title_zh: 课堂插话：人工细胞与"镜像生命"（D-型氨基酸、镜像核糖体）的风险
title_en: Class digression: artificial cells and "mirror life" — D-amino acids, a mirror ribosome, and the risk

points.zh: 从"酶的高度专一性"岔开：老师提到前一天看到的新闻，说 Science 上有新文章，首次有人工的细胞开始产生东西了。
points.en: The digression starts from enzyme specificity: the teacher mentions a news item from the day before about a new Science paper in which an artificial cell has, for the first time, begun producing something.

points.zh: 他说还有更离谱的：北大有人在做的东西叫做镜像生命 mirror life。
points.en: He says there is something more outlandish still: someone at Peking University is working on what is called mirror life.

points.zh: 前提是前面讲过的：组成生命的氨基酸都是 L 型的氨基酸。
points.en: The premise comes from earlier in the course: the amino acids that make up life are all of the L configuration.

points.zh: 那位研究者用化学手段合成 D 型氨基酸，再把 D 型氨基酸一个一个连成肽键，做出一个完全镜像的 D 型蛋白。
points.en: The researcher chemically synthesises D-amino acids and links them one by one through peptide bonds, producing an entirely mirror-image D-protein.

points.zh: 下一步是攻克镜像核糖体：镜像的核糖体做出来以后，就可以生物学地大量生产镜像蛋白质。
points.en: The next step is a mirror ribosome: once that exists, mirror proteins could be produced biologically and in quantity.

points.zh: 风险在于自然界现在没有这种东西——如果突然出现一个镜像的病毒或镜像的细菌，人类现有的所有技术都没有办法攻克它。
points.en: The risk is that nothing like this exists in nature — if a mirror virus or a mirror bacterium appeared, no technology humans currently have could deal with it.

points.zh: 免疫学上的道理：人的抗体是 L 型的蛋白，很难高特异性地识别 D 型蛋白，"人家整个跟你是反过来的，你抓不住它"，免疫系统等于直接崩了。
points.en: The immunological reason: human antibodies are L-proteins and can hardly recognise a D-protein with high specificity — "the whole thing is reversed relative to you, you cannot get hold of it" — so the immune system simply fails.

points.zh: 老师认为相比之下，南科大贺建奎的基因编辑婴儿"是小儿科"、是哗众取宠；真正可怕的是这种默默在做的镜像生命，甚至不需要是 coronavirus，任何一个流感、细菌、益生菌都足够。
points.en: By comparison, the teacher regards He Jiankui's gene-edited babies as "kid stuff" and mere grandstanding; what frightens him is mirror life pursued quietly — and it would not even take a coronavirus, any influenza virus, bacterium or probiotic would do.

extra.zh: D 型氨基酸在自然界并非不存在：细菌细胞壁肽聚糖的交联肽含 D-Ala 和 D-Glu（由消旋酶从 L 型转化而来，青霉素正是抑制 D-Ala-D-Ala 的交联），短杆菌肽 gramicidin S 等非核糖体肽含 D-Phe，哺乳动物脑内的 D-Ser 是 NMDA 受体的共激动剂。真正在自然界中不存在的，是"整条链全部由 D 型氨基酸构成的蛋白质"。
extra.en: D-amino acids are not absent from nature: the cross-linking peptides of bacterial peptidoglycan contain D-Ala and D-Glu (made by racemases from the L forms — penicillin blocks exactly the D-Ala-D-Ala cross-link), non-ribosomal peptides such as gramicidin S contain D-Phe, and D-Ser in the mammalian brain is a co-agonist at the NMDA receptor. What genuinely does not exist in nature is a protein whose entire chain is D-amino acids.

extra.zh: 手性命名要分清两套体系：L/D 是 Fischer 相对构型，以 L-甘油醛为参照；R/S 是 CIP 绝对构型。除半胱氨酸 Cys 因硫原子优先级高而是 (R) 之外，其余天然 L-氨基酸都是 (S)；甘氨酸 Gly 的 α 碳上有两个氢，没有手性中心，不分 L/D。
extra.en: Two chirality systems must be kept apart: L/D is Fischer relative configuration referenced to L-glyceraldehyde, while R/S is CIP absolute configuration. Every natural L-amino acid is (S) except cysteine, which is (R) because sulfur outranks the other substituents; glycine carries two hydrogens on its α-carbon, has no stereocentre, and is neither L nor D.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 镜像分子并不是"只有毁灭性用途"。正因为蛋白酶有立体专一性、认不出 D 型底物，D 型肽在体内几乎不被降解、半衰期长、免疫原性低，这是明确的药物优势。镜像噬菌体展示 mirror-image phage display 就是利用这一点筛选 D-肽药物的成熟策略。老师说"不知道意义在哪"，实际的近期意义主要在这里。
extra.en: Mirror molecules are not purely destructive. Precisely because proteases are stereospecific and cannot recognise a D-substrate, D-peptides resist degradation in vivo, have long half-lives and low immunogenicity — a clear drug-design advantage. Mirror-image phage display is an established strategy that exploits this to select D-peptide therapeutics. Where the teacher says he cannot see the point, this is the near-term point.

extra.zh: 把这段插话接回本章主题：酶的立体专一性正是关键。L 型的酶（包括蛋白酶、聚合酶、代谢酶）与 D 型底物几乎不结合，所以镜像生物既不能被我们的酶降解，也不能利用环境中天然的 L-氨基酸和 D-糖——它"营养与降解两头都对不上"。既有生物防御和生态制约手段对它同时失效，这才是生物安全担忧的核心。
extra.en: Tie the digression back to the chapter: enzyme stereospecificity is the crux. L-enzymes — proteases, polymerases, metabolic enzymes alike — barely bind D-substrates, so a mirror organism could neither be degraded by our enzymes nor feed on the natural L-amino acids and D-sugars around it; it is mismatched at both the nutrition and the degradation end. Existing biological defences and ecological checks would fail simultaneously, which is the core of the biosafety concern.

quiz.q_zh: 天然蛋白质中的氨基酸绝大多数是哪种构型？
quiz.q_en: Which configuration do almost all amino acids in natural proteins have?

options.zh: 内消旋型
options.en: A meso configuration

options.zh: D 型
options.en: The D configuration

options.zh: 外消旋型
options.en: A racemic mixture

options.zh: L 型
options.en: The L configuration

quiz.explain_zh: 核糖体只装配 L-氨基酸，所以天然蛋白质是均一的 L 型手性。外消旋是 L 与 D 等量混合，化学合成才会得到；内消旋要求分子内有对称面，单个氨基酸不具备这种结构。
quiz.explain_en: The ribosome assembles only L-amino acids, so a natural protein is uniformly L in chirality. A racemate is an equal mixture of L and D and arises from chemical synthesis, while a meso form requires an internal mirror plane, which a single amino acid does not have.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么人的抗体很难识别镜像的 D 型蛋白？
quiz.q_en: Why can human antibodies barely recognise a mirror-image D-protein?

options.zh: D 型蛋白不带任何抗原表位
options.en: D-proteins carry no antigenic epitopes

options.zh: 抗原识别依赖手性互补的表面
options.en: Antigen recognition needs matching chirality

options.zh: D 型蛋白的分子量过于小
options.en: D-proteins are far too small in mass

options.zh: 抗体只识别糖类而不识别蛋白
options.en: Antibodies see only sugars, not proteins

quiz.explain_zh: 抗体的互补决定区由 L-氨基酸构成，它与抗原的结合靠形状和化学基团的三维互补；把抗原整体做成镜像后，这种互补关系被破坏，结合力和特异性都急剧下降。D 型蛋白本身有完整的表面结构和大小，抗体也主要识别蛋白抗原。
quiz.explain_en: An antibody's complementarity-determining regions are built from L-amino acids and bind antigen through three-dimensional complementarity of shape and chemical groups; mirroring the whole antigen destroys that complementarity, collapsing both affinity and specificity. A D-protein has a full surface and normal size, and antibodies principally recognise protein antigens.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪种 D 型氨基酸在自然界中确实常见？
quiz.q_en: Which of these D-amino acids really is common in nature?

options.zh: 线粒体基质蛋白中的 D-Met
options.en: D-Met inside mitochondrial matrix proteins

options.zh: 胶原三螺旋中的 D-Pro
options.en: D-Pro within the collagen triple helix

options.zh: 细菌肽聚糖中的 D-Ala
options.en: D-Ala in bacterial peptidoglycan

options.zh: 真核核糖体合成的 D-Leu
options.en: D-Leu made by eukaryotic ribosomes

quiz.explain_zh: 肽聚糖的交联短肽含 D-Ala 和 D-Glu，由消旋酶从 L 型转化而来，青霉素就是通过阻断 D-Ala-D-Ala 交联杀菌的。核糖体（无论原核还是真核）只装配 L-氨基酸，线粒体蛋白和胶原蛋白同样由核糖体合成，都不含 D 型残基。
quiz.explain_en: The short cross-linking peptides of peptidoglycan contain D-Ala and D-Glu, produced from the L forms by racemases; penicillin kills bacteria by blocking that D-Ala-D-Ala cross-link. Ribosomes, prokaryotic and eukaryotic alike, assemble only L-amino acids, and mitochondrial proteins and collagen are ribosomally made, so neither contains D-residues.

title_zh: 酶活力调节（一）：改变酶的"量"——诱导阻遏与乳糖操纵子
title_en: Regulating enzyme activity I: changing the amount of enzyme — induction, repression and the lac operon

points.zh: 回到正题：酶具有高度的专一性，这是有利有弊的——催化效率高，但它只能催化特定的那一个反应。
points.en: Back to the subject: high specificity cuts both ways — the catalytic efficiency is high, but the enzyme can only catalyse its one particular reaction.

points.zh: 酶的活力可以通过什么方式调节，是必须知道的，因为之后做实验会经常涉及"这个酶的活力到底受什么因素、受什么底物影响"。
points.en: How enzyme activity can be regulated has to be known, because the question of what factors and what substrates affect a given enzyme's activity comes up constantly in the experiments ahead.

points.zh: 第一，酶的活力肯定受酶的浓度影响：在一个体系内，酶的浓度不同，催化反应的活力就不同。
points.en: First, activity certainly depends on enzyme concentration: within one system, different enzyme concentrations give different catalytic activity.

points.zh: 第二，受诱导和抑制的影响。这里讲的仍是生化意义上的酶活力：某些产物、某些激素会让这个酶的合成与表达受到抑制，或者受到激活。
points.en: Second, induction and repression. Still in the biochemical sense of activity: certain products and certain hormones cause the synthesis and expression of the enzyme to be repressed, or to be activated.

points.zh: 老师在这里明确标注：这是"最慢最慢"的一种调节酶活力的方式，因为它作用在基因表达的层面。
points.en: The teacher labels this explicitly as the very slowest way of regulating enzyme activity, because it acts at the level of gene expression.

points.zh: 举的例子是乳糖操纵子 lac operon：加入 IPTG，从基因的层面来促进蛋白质的合成，或者抑制蛋白质的合成。
points.en: The example is the lac operon: add IPTG and, at the level of the gene, protein synthesis is promoted — or suppressed.

points.zh: 所以诱导大肠杆菌为什么要十几个小时：一方面低温下合成蛋白质本来就慢；另一方面老师认为乳糖操纵子的启动大约要两三个小时才会发生。
points.en: Hence why inducing E. coli takes a dozen-plus hours: partly because protein synthesis at low temperature is inherently slow, and partly because — in the teacher's account — the lac operon takes some two to three hours to fire.

points.zh: 也就是说加入 IPTG 以后不是立即表达，而是两三个小时以后才启动目的蛋白的表达，或者启动对本底无关蛋白表达的抑制。
points.en: That is, expression does not start the moment IPTG goes in; on his account it takes two to three hours before the target protein is expressed, or before background expression of irrelevant proteins is suppressed.

extra.zh: lac operon 的机制补全：阻遏蛋白 LacI 结合在 operator 上阻断转录；诱导物结合 LacI 使其构象改变、从 operator 上脱落，转录随即开始。生理诱导物是异乳糖 allolactose，实验室用 IPTG，因为它不被 β-半乳糖苷酶水解，浓度稳定、诱导持续，属于 gratuitous inducer（无偿诱导物）。
extra.en: Filling in the lac operon mechanism: the LacI repressor sits on the operator and blocks transcription; an inducer binds LacI, changes its conformation and releases it from the operator, whereupon transcription begins. The physiological inducer is allolactose; the laboratory uses IPTG because β-galactosidase cannot hydrolyse it, so its concentration holds steady and induction is sustained — a gratuitous inducer.

extra.zh: 乳糖操纵子还有正调控的一半：葡萄糖存在时胞内 cAMP 低，CAP(CRP)-cAMP 复合物无法结合启动子上游位点，即使没有阻遏蛋白，转录仍然很弱。这就是分解代谢物阻遏 catabolite repression，也是大肠杆菌在葡萄糖+乳糖培养基上出现二次生长曲线 diauxie 的原因。
extra.en: The lac operon also has a positive half: when glucose is present, intracellular cAMP is low, the CAP(CRP)-cAMP complex cannot bind its site upstream of the promoter, and transcription stays weak even with the repressor gone. This is catabolite repression, and it is why E. coli grown on glucose plus lactose shows a diauxic growth curve.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 乳糖操纵子的去阻遏其实很快，不需要两三个小时：加入诱导物后几分钟内就能检测到 lacZ mRNA 和 β-半乳糖苷酶活性（这是 Jacob 与 Monod 的经典实验结果）。过夜诱导十几个小时的真实原因，是让目的蛋白在低温下缓慢累积到足够的量并正确折叠，而不是等操纵子"启动"。
extra.en: Derepression of the lac operon is in fact fast and does not need two to three hours: lacZ mRNA and β-galactosidase activity are detectable within minutes of adding inducer — the classic Jacob and Monod result. The real reason for inducing overnight is to let the target protein accumulate slowly at low temperature to sufficient quantity, correctly folded, not to wait for the operon to start.

extra.zh: 常规诱导条件：培养到 OD₆₀₀ 约 0.4–0.8 时加 IPTG，终浓度通常 0.1–1 mM；37 ℃ 诱导 3–4 小时，或降到 16–18 ℃ 过夜诱导 12–20 小时。低温过夜的目的是减慢翻译速率、给新生肽链留出折叠时间，从而减少包涵体 inclusion body。
extra.en: Standard induction conditions: add IPTG at OD₆₀₀ around 0.4–0.8, typically to a final 0.1–1 mM; then either 3–4 hours at 37 °C or 12–20 hours overnight at 16–18 °C. The point of the cold overnight route is to slow translation and give nascent chains time to fold, cutting down on inclusion bodies.

quiz.q_zh: IPTG 诱导表达时，它的直接分子作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: When IPTG induces expression, what does it do at the molecular level?

options.zh: 结合 LacI 阻遏蛋白使其脱离 operator
options.en: Binds LacI repressor, releasing the operator

options.zh: 结合 RNA 聚合酶提高其转录活性
options.en: Binds RNA polymerase, raising its activity

options.zh: 被 β-半乳糖苷酶水解为半乳糖
options.en: Is hydrolysed by β-galactosidase to galactose

options.zh: 结合核糖体 30S 亚基加快翻译
options.en: Binds the 30S subunit to speed translation

quiz.explain_zh: IPTG 是异乳糖的结构类似物，作用是结合阻遏蛋白 LacI 使其构象改变、从 operator 上脱落，转录随之解除阻遏。它恰恰不被 β-半乳糖苷酶水解，因此浓度不会随诱导下降；它也不与 RNA 聚合酶或核糖体发生作用。
quiz.explain_en: IPTG is a structural analogue of allolactose whose action is to bind the LacI repressor, change its conformation and pull it off the operator, lifting repression of transcription. It is specifically not hydrolysed by β-galactosidase, so its concentration does not fall during induction, and it acts on neither RNA polymerase nor the ribosome.

quiz.q_zh: 通过诱导或阻遏改变酶的合成，属于哪一类调节？
quiz.q_en: Changing enzyme synthesis by induction or repression is what kind of regulation?

options.zh: 不改变酶量的共价修饰调节
options.en: Covalent control keeping enzyme amount fixed

options.zh: 只在体外发生的人工调节
options.en: Artificial control happening only in vitro

options.zh: 最快的、以毫秒计的调节
options.en: Fastest control, on a millisecond scale

options.zh: 最慢的、基因表达层面的调节
options.en: Slowest control, at the expression level

quiz.explain_zh: 诱导和阻遏必须经过转录和翻译才能改变细胞里酶分子的数量，因此是最慢的一层调控，课上把它标为"最慢最慢"。以毫秒计的是别构效应，共价修饰改变的是单个酶分子的活性而非数量，而这类调控在活细胞内本来就在发生。
quiz.explain_en: Induction and repression must run through transcription and translation before the number of enzyme molecules in the cell changes, making this the slowest tier — the lecture marks it as the very slowest. Millisecond-scale regulation is allosteric, covalent modification alters the activity of individual molecules rather than their number, and this kind of control operates in living cells, not only in vitro.

quiz.q_zh: 在 16–18 ℃ 过夜诱导表达，主要目的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main purpose of inducing expression overnight at 16–18 °C?

options.zh: 提高目的蛋白的可溶性
options.en: Improve solubility of the target protein

options.zh: 增强抗生素的筛选压力
options.en: Strengthen antibiotic selection pressure

options.zh: 加快乳糖操纵子的启动速度
options.en: Speed up firing of the lac operon

options.zh: 显著提高质粒的拷贝数
options.en: Sharply raise plasmid copy number

quiz.explain_zh: 低温减慢翻译速率，让新生肽链有足够时间正确折叠，从而减少包涵体 inclusion body 的形成、提高可溶表达量。操纵子的去阻遏本来就在几分钟内完成，质粒拷贝数由复制起点决定，抗生素压力由培养基里的抗生素浓度决定，都与温度无关。
quiz.explain_en: Low temperature slows translation so that nascent chains have time to fold correctly, reducing inclusion-body formation and raising soluble yield. Derepression of the operon happens within minutes regardless, plasmid copy number is set by the origin of replication, and selection pressure is set by the antibiotic in the medium — none of them by temperature.

title_zh: 酶活力调节（二）：酶的降解、激酶与肿瘤；酶量与酶活性之分
title_en: Regulating enzyme activity II: enzyme degradation, kinases and tumours; amount versus activity

points.zh: 调节酶的量的另一条途径是酶的降解，老师主要用激酶 kinase 来举例。
points.en: The other route to regulating the amount of enzyme is degradation, and the teacher illustrates it mainly with kinases.

points.zh: 有一些激酶负责把蛋白磷酸化。它把该磷酸化的某几个蛋白磷酸化以后，这个激酶本身就会被降解。
points.en: Some kinases are responsible for phosphorylating proteins. Once such a kinase has phosphorylated the few proteins it is meant to act on, the kinase itself is degraded.

points.zh: 激酶被降解以后就不能接着磷酸化了——降解在这里是关掉信号的手段。
points.en: With the kinase degraded it can no longer keep phosphorylating — degradation here is the means of switching the signal off.

points.zh: 如果一个激酶持续地发挥作用，把所有这些蛋白都磷酸化了，往往的结果是：细胞内原本有序的功能变得无序。
points.en: If a kinase keeps acting and phosphorylates all of those proteins, the usual result is that ordered cellular function becomes disordered.

points.zh: 这个现象在肿瘤里特别特别严重：很多肿瘤的产生就是因为一些激酶发挥了作用、传递了肿瘤细胞的生长信号，但没有被及时降解。
points.en: This is especially severe in tumours: many tumours arise because a kinase has acted and transmitted a growth signal to the cell but has not been degraded in time.

points.zh: 于是它无限地传递细胞的生长信号，导致细胞无限地扩增。
points.en: It then transmits the growth signal without limit, and the cell proliferates without limit.

points.zh: 小结上半段：酶浓度这一类调节，是从酶的数量上来决定整个催化活力。
points.en: Summing up the first half: regulation of the enzyme-concentration kind determines total catalytic activity through the number of enzyme molecules.

points.zh: 与之相对，下面要讲的"酶的活性"是从单个酶分子催化的能力上来调节；老师说酶活性调节的因素就很多了。
points.en: By contrast, what comes next — enzyme activity proper — regulates the catalytic capability of the individual enzyme molecule, and the teacher notes that there are a great many factors involved.

extra.zh: 关掉一个激酶最主要、最常用的方式其实不是降解它，而是由磷酸酶 phosphatase 把底物去磷酸化——磷酸化是可逆的共价修饰，激酶与磷酸酶成对工作。此外还有抑制蛋白结合、第二信使浓度下降、受体内吞等更快的机制。蛋白降解是其中最慢、最彻底、不可逆的一种。
extra.en: The main and most common way a kinase signal is switched off is not degradation of the kinase but dephosphorylation of its substrates by a phosphatase — phosphorylation is a reversible covalent modification, and kinases work in pairs with phosphatases. Faster mechanisms also exist: inhibitor-protein binding, falling second-messenger levels, receptor internalisation. Degradation is the slowest, most complete and irreversible of the set.

extra.zh: 真核细胞里蛋白降解的主渠道是泛素-蛋白酶体系统 ubiquitin-proteasome system：E1 活化酶、E2 结合酶、E3 连接酶级联把 K48 连接的多聚泛素链挂到底物赖氨酸上，26S 蛋白酶体再以 ATP 依赖的方式识别并降解它。底物特异性由 E3 连接酶决定，这也是很多靶向降解药物的作用点。
extra.en: The main route of protein degradation in eukaryotes is the ubiquitin-proteasome system: an E1 activating, E2 conjugating and E3 ligase cascade attaches a K48-linked polyubiquitin chain to a substrate lysine, and the 26S proteasome then recognises and degrades it in an ATP-dependent manner. Substrate specificity resides in the E3 ligase, which is also where many targeted-degradation drugs act.

extra.zh: 课上"激酶没被及时关掉就致癌"可以配几个具体例子：慢性髓性白血病 CML 的 BCR-ABL 融合激酶因失去自身调控而持续激活，伊马替尼 imatinib 就是针对它的抑制剂；肺腺癌中的 EGFR 激活突变、黑色素瘤中的 BRAF V600E 也是同一逻辑——激酶被锁定在"开"的状态。
extra.en: The lecture's "a kinase not switched off in time causes cancer" is worth pinning to concrete cases: the BCR-ABL fusion kinase of chronic myeloid leukaemia is constitutively active because it has lost its own regulatory control, and imatinib is the inhibitor built against it; activating EGFR mutations in lung adenocarcinoma and BRAF V600E in melanoma follow the same logic — a kinase locked in the "on" state.

extra.zh: 把两条时间尺度分清，这正是考试爱问的"哪种是快速调节"：调节酶的量（转录、翻译、降解）以分钟到小时计，属于粗调、不可逆；调节单个酶的活性（别构效应、共价修饰、抑制剂结合）以毫秒到秒计，属于细调、可逆。老师接着要讲的别构效应就是最快的那一端。
extra.en: Keep the two time scales apart — this is exactly the "which one is rapid regulation" exam question. Regulating the amount of enzyme (transcription, translation, degradation) runs on minutes to hours and is coarse and irreversible; regulating the activity of the individual molecule (allostery, covalent modification, inhibitor binding) runs on milliseconds to seconds and is fine-grained and reversible. The allosteric effect the teacher turns to next is the fast extreme.

quiz.q_zh: 激酶 kinase 催化的是什么反应？
quiz.q_en: What reaction does a kinase catalyse?

options.zh: 把甲基从底物上转移出去
options.en: Transfers a methyl group off the substrate

options.zh: 把磷酸基团从底物上移去
options.en: Removes a phosphate group from substrate

options.zh: 把磷酸基团转移到底物上
options.en: Transfers a phosphate group onto substrate

options.zh: 把底物水解成两个小片段
options.en: Hydrolyses the substrate into two fragments

quiz.explain_zh: 激酶是转移酶，把 ATP 的 γ-磷酸转移到底物的 Ser、Thr 或 Tyr 羟基上（细菌双组分系统中转到 His）。移去磷酸的是磷酸酶 phosphatase，水解成片段的是水解酶，转移甲基的是甲基转移酶。
quiz.explain_en: A kinase is a transferase: it moves the γ-phosphate of ATP onto a Ser, Thr or Tyr hydroxyl of the substrate (onto His in bacterial two-component systems). Removing phosphate is the job of a phosphatase, cleaving into fragments that of a hydrolase, and moving methyl groups that of a methyltransferase.

quiz.q_zh: 按课上的说法，激酶没有被及时降解会导致什么？
quiz.q_en: On the lecture's account, what follows if a kinase is not degraded in time?

options.zh: 细胞的膜脂合成被完全阻断
options.en: Membrane lipid synthesis is completely blocked

options.zh: 底物蛋白被彻底去磷酸化并失活
options.en: Substrate proteins are fully dephosphorylated

options.zh: 细胞随即进入不可逆的静止期
options.en: The cell enters an irreversible resting state

options.zh: 生长信号持续传递，细胞无限增殖
options.en: Growth signalling persists, cells overproliferate

quiz.explain_zh: 激酶不被降解就会继续磷酸化下游蛋白、无限传递生长信号，细胞内原本有序的功能变得无序，表现为无限扩增——这正是许多肿瘤的发生机制。去磷酸化是磷酸酶的作用而非激酶残留的结果，静止期和膜脂合成都与这条信号的持续激活相反或无关。
quiz.explain_en: A kinase that escapes degradation keeps phosphorylating its downstream targets and relaying the growth signal without limit, so ordered cellular function turns disordered and the cells proliferate without bound — the mechanism behind many tumours. Dephosphorylation is what a phosphatase does, not a consequence of the kinase persisting, and a resting state or blocked lipid synthesis is either the opposite of, or unrelated to, sustained activation of this pathway.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项调节的是酶的"量"而不是单个酶分子的活性？
quiz.q_en: Which of these regulates the amount of enzyme rather than each molecule's activity?

options.zh: 泛素化后被蛋白酶体降解
options.en: Ubiquitination and degradation by the proteasome

options.zh: 抑制剂结合到酶的活性位点
options.en: Inhibitor binding at the enzyme active site

options.zh: 别构效应改变酶的构象
options.en: Allosteric change in enzyme conformation

options.zh: 对酶的可逆共价磷酸化修饰
options.en: Reversible covalent phosphorylation of the enzyme

quiz.explain_zh: 泛素化并被 26S 蛋白酶体降解，直接减少细胞内这种酶的分子数目，属于"量"的调节，与转录、翻译水平的调控同一层次。别构效应、共价磷酸化和抑制剂结合都不改变酶的分子数，只改变每个分子的催化能力，而且都是可逆的快速调节。
quiz.explain_en: Ubiquitination followed by 26S proteasome degradation directly reduces how many molecules of that enzyme the cell contains — regulation of amount, on the same tier as transcriptional and translational control. Allostery, covalent phosphorylation and inhibitor binding leave molecule number untouched and change only what each molecule can do, all reversibly and fast.

title_zh: 酶的化学本质：蛋白质酶与核酶，核酶 vs RNase
title_en: Chemical nature of enzymes: protein enzymes vs ribozymes, ribozyme vs RNase

points.zh: 别构效应（allosteric effect）是调节酶活性最快的方式之一：血红蛋白只需几个皮秒（ps）就能完成构象变化，随即提高结合氧气的能力。
points.en: The allosteric effect is among the fastest ways to modulate enzyme activity: haemoglobin needs only a few picoseconds (ps) to change conformation and thereby raise its oxygen-binding ability.

points.zh: 酶的化学组成与本质：除少数核酶（ribozyme）以外，绝大多数酶都是蛋白质。
points.en: Chemical composition and nature of enzymes: apart from a small number of ribozymes, the overwhelming majority of enzymes are proteins.

points.zh: 蛋白质类的酶具备一般蛋白质应有的全部性质（两性解离、可被变性、可被蛋白水解酶降解等）。
points.en: Protein enzymes have all the properties any protein has (amphoteric behaviour, denaturability, susceptibility to proteolysis).

points.zh: 核酶（ribozyme）的本质就是 RNA——一段特殊折叠的 RNA，却能发挥酶的催化功能，不含蛋白质骨架。
points.en: A ribozyme is RNA in nature: a specially folded stretch of RNA that nevertheless performs enzymatic catalysis, with no protein backbone.

points.zh: RNase（核糖核酸酶）本质是蛋白质，是降解或作用于 RNA 的酶，与核酶完全不是一回事，只是中文把两者都念作“RNA酶”才容易混。
points.en: An RNase (ribonuclease) is a protein, an enzyme that degrades or acts on RNA. It is a completely different thing from a ribozyme; only the shared Chinese wording 'RNA enzyme' makes them look alike.

points.zh: 因此被问“酶有几类”时必须答两类：蛋白质酶和核酶（RNA），不能说酶全部由蛋白质组成。
points.en: So when asked how many kinds of enzyme exist, answer two: protein enzymes and ribozymes (RNA). Never say all enzymes are made of protein.

extra.zh: 老师一开始说“核酶就是RNA酶”，把 ribozyme 和 RNase 混为一谈，随后他自己纠正了。正确说法：ribozyme = 具催化活性的 RNA；RNase = 降解 RNA 的蛋白质。RNase P 恰好是两者的交界——它的催化亚基是 RNA。
extra.en: The lecturer first says 'a ribozyme is just an RNA enzyme', conflating ribozyme with RNase, and then corrects himself. Correct: a ribozyme is catalytic RNA; an RNase is a protein that degrades RNA. RNase P sits exactly on the boundary, since its catalytic subunit is the RNA.

extra.zh: 催化性 RNA 由 Cech 与 Altman 发现，1989年获诺贝尔化学奖。天然核酶包括自剪接内含子（group I/II intron）、锤头核酶（hammerhead）、RNase P 的 RNA 亚基，以及核糖体的肽基转移中心——核糖体本质上是一个核酶。
extra.en: Catalytic RNA was discovered by Cech and Altman, Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1989. Natural ribozymes include self-splicing group I/II introns, the hammerhead ribozyme, the RNA subunit of RNase P, and the peptidyl transferase centre of the ribosome, which makes the ribosome itself a ribozyme.

extra.zh: “几个皮秒”是数量级上的说法。血红蛋白局部侧链与三级结构的重排确在皮秒–纳秒尺度，但完整的 T→R 四级结构转换在微秒量级。要点是别构调节比“合成新酶／降解酶”快许多个数量级。
extra.en: 'A few picoseconds' is an order-of-magnitude statement. Local side-chain and tertiary rearrangements in haemoglobin are indeed picosecond-to-nanosecond, but the full T-to-R quaternary transition is on the microsecond scale. The point stands: allosteric control is orders of magnitude faster than making or destroying enzyme molecules.

quiz.q_zh: 关于核酶（ribozyme）与 RNase 的本质，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the nature of a ribozyme versus an RNase is correct?

options.zh: 两者本质都是蛋白质，只是折叠不同
options.en: Both are proteins and differ only in folding

options.zh: 核酶本质是RNA，RNase本质是蛋白质
options.en: A ribozyme is RNA; an RNase is a protein

options.zh: 核酶本质是蛋白质，RNase本质是RNA
options.en: A ribozyme is a protein; an RNase is RNA

options.zh: 两者本质都是RNA，只是底物不同
options.en: Both are RNA and differ only in substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 核酶是一段能催化反应的 RNA；RNase 是作用于 RNA 的蛋白质酶。说“核酶是蛋白质、RNase 是RNA”正好把两者颠倒；说“两者都是RNA”或“两者都是蛋白质”都抹掉了这条关键界线。
quiz.explain_en: A ribozyme is catalytic RNA; an RNase is a protein enzyme acting on RNA. The choice saying the ribozyme is protein and the RNase is RNA reverses them, while the two choices making both the same class erase the key distinction.

quiz.q_zh: 关于酶的化学本质，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about the chemical nature of enzymes is correct?

options.zh: 绝大多数酶是RNA，少数是蛋白质
options.en: Most enzymes are RNA; a few are proteins

options.zh: 所有的酶都是蛋白质，没有例外
options.en: All enzymes are proteins, with no exception

options.zh: 所有的酶都含金属离子辅因子
options.en: All enzymes carry a metal-ion cofactor

options.zh: 绝大多数酶是蛋白质，少数是RNA
options.en: Most enzymes are proteins; a few are RNA

quiz.explain_zh: 核酶的存在使“所有酶都是蛋白质”成为错误命题；但核酶只是少数，主体仍是蛋白质，所以“绝大多数是RNA”也不对。金属离子只是部分结合酶的辅因子，单纯酶并不需要。
quiz.explain_en: Ribozymes make 'all enzymes are proteins' false, yet they are the minority, so 'most enzymes are RNA' is wrong too. Metal ions are cofactors of only some conjugated enzymes; simple enzymes need none.

quiz.q_zh: 与调节酶的数量（酶浓度）相比，别构效应的特点是？
quiz.q_en: Compared with regulating enzyme amount (enzyme concentration), what characterises the allosteric effect?

options.zh: 降解酶分子，不改变活性
options.en: Enzyme degradation, activity unchanged

options.zh: 只见于核酶，不见于蛋白酶
options.en: Found in ribozymes but not in proteins

options.zh: 靠构象改变瞬时调节活性
options.en: A conformational change alters activity

options.zh: 合成新酶，缓慢调节酶量
options.en: New enzyme synthesis slowly alters amount

quiz.explain_zh: 别构调节通过既有酶分子的构象变化瞬时改变活性，血红蛋白是范例。“靠新蛋白合成”描述的是酶浓度调节；“只改变数量不改变活性”自相矛盾；别构现象在蛋白质酶中最常见，并不限于核酶。
quiz.explain_en: Allosteric control changes activity instantly through the conformation of enzyme molecules already present, haemoglobin being the model. Acting by new protein synthesis describes concentration control; changing number without changing activity contradicts the term; and allostery is chiefly a protein-enzyme phenomenon, not a ribozyme-only one.

title_zh: 核酶实例 flexizyme 与镜像生命（mirror-image life）
title_en: A ribozyme in practice: flexizyme, and mirror-image life

points.zh: 图中蓝色的是 tRNA，橙色的是 flexizyme——一段特殊折叠的 RNA，是核酶的一个具体例子。
points.en: In the slide the blue molecule is a tRNA and the orange one is flexizyme, a specially folded stretch of RNA and a concrete example of a ribozyme.

points.zh: flexizyme 的作用是把氨基酸连接到 tRNA 上，而且可以把任意一种氨基酸连上去。
points.en: Flexizyme attaches an amino acid to a tRNA, and it can load essentially any amino acid.

points.zh: 它在功能上相当于核酸课里学过的氨酰tRNA合成酶（aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase, aaRS），区别在于 aaRS 是蛋白质，flexizyme 是 RNA。
points.en: Functionally it does the job of the aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase (aaRS) met in the nucleic-acid course; the difference is that aaRS is a protein while flexizyme is RNA.

points.zh: flexizyme 只是这一种核酶的名字，不是这一类分子的统称；核酶这一类的英文是 ribozyme。
points.en: Flexizyme is the name of that one ribozyme, not the name of the class; the class term in English is ribozyme.

points.zh: 由此引出“镜像生命”（mirror-image life）的工作，代表人物是原清华大学的朱听，还有其他团队在做。
points.en: This leads into work on mirror-image life, associated with Zhu Ting, formerly of Tsinghua University, among other groups.

points.zh: 示意图左边是天然（natural）的 tRNA，右边是人工合成的镜像版本，镜像核酶给镜像 tRNA 加载。
points.en: In the diagram the left-hand tRNA is the natural one and the right-hand one is the synthetic mirror-image version, charged by a mirror-image ribozyme.

points.zh: 老师把这类工作与在座做的重组体病毒／受体结合改造相提并论，都属于“创新但敏感、难发表”的方向；随后约三分半钟是关于实验室合作、高福团队做受体结合测定、以及赴美签证的闲聊，无考点。
points.en: The lecturer puts this alongside the listener's work on recombinant viruses and receptor binding as innovative but sensitive and hard to publish. The next three and a half minutes are small talk about lab collaborations, receptor-binding assays in George Gao's group, and US visa concerns, with no examinable content.

extra.zh: 讲镜像 tRNA 时老师说“核酶可以把 RNA 连到 tRNA 上”，应为“把氨基酸连到 tRNA 上”。这一步叫氨酰化／上载（aminoacylation, charging），产物是氨酰-tRNA（aminoacyl-tRNA）。他前一段说的是对的，只是这里口误。
extra.en: While describing the mirror-image tRNA the lecturer says the ribozyme 'attaches RNA to the tRNA'; he means an amino acid. The step is aminoacylation (charging) and the product is an aminoacyl-tRNA. His earlier statement was correct; this is a slip.

extra.zh: flexizyme 是体外进化（in vitro selection）得到的核酶，能用活化的天然或非天然氨基酸给任意 tRNA 上载，是遗传密码重编程与非天然氨基酸掺入的核心工具。而天然的 aaRS 是两步反应：氨基酸 + ATP → 氨酰-AMP + PPi，再把氨酰基转到 tRNA 的3'端，释放 AMP，并具有校对（proofreading／editing）功能。
extra.en: Flexizyme is a ribozyme obtained by in vitro selection; it charges any tRNA with activated natural or non-natural amino acids, making it the key tool for genetic-code reprogramming and non-canonical amino-acid incorporation. Natural aaRS works in two steps: amino acid + ATP gives aminoacyl-AMP plus PPi, then the aminoacyl group is transferred to the 3' end of the tRNA releasing AMP, with a proofreading or editing activity built in.

extra.zh: tRNA 的“L 形”指的是三级结构的形状（三叶草二级结构折成 L 形），而镜像生命里的 L 型指的是手性构型。天然核酸用 D-核糖，天然蛋白质用 L-氨基酸；镜像体系正好反过来，用 L-核糖和 D-氨基酸，因此天然酶不认识它、也几乎不被降解。
extra.en: The 'L shape' of a tRNA refers to its tertiary fold (the cloverleaf secondary structure folds into an L), whereas 'L form' in mirror-image life refers to chirality. Natural nucleic acids use D-ribose and natural proteins use L-amino acids; the mirror system inverts both, using L-ribose and D-amino acids, so natural enzymes neither recognise nor readily degrade it.

extra.zh: 核酶的天然种类：group I/II 自剪接内含子、锤头（hammerhead）与发夹（hairpin）核酶、丁肝病毒（HDV）核酶、glmS 核糖开关、RNase P 的 RNA 亚基，以及核糖体 23S rRNA 的肽基转移中心。这支持“RNA world”假说。
extra.en: Natural ribozyme families: self-splicing group I and II introns, hammerhead and hairpin ribozymes, the HDV ribozyme, the glmS riboswitch, the RNA subunit of RNase P, and the peptidyl transferase centre in 23S rRNA. These underpin the RNA world hypothesis.

quiz.q_zh: flexizyme 这个核酶的功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the ribozyme flexizyme do?

options.zh: 把氨基酸连接成多肽链
options.en: It joins amino acids into a peptide

options.zh: 把氨基酸连接到tRNA上
options.en: It attaches an amino acid to a tRNA

options.zh: 把RNA连接到tRNA上
options.en: It attaches an RNA to a tRNA

options.zh: 把tRNA降解为核苷酸
options.en: It degrades a tRNA to nucleotides

quiz.explain_zh: flexizyme 催化氨酰化（aminoacylation），把（几乎任意）氨基酸上载到 tRNA 的3'端。“把RNA连到tRNA上”正是课上的口误；降解 tRNA 是核酸酶的活性；把氨基酸连成肽链是核糖体肽基转移中心的活性。
quiz.explain_en: Flexizyme catalyses aminoacylation, loading (almost any) amino acid onto the 3' end of a tRNA. Attaching an RNA to the tRNA is exactly the lecturer's slip; degrading tRNA is nuclease activity; joining amino acids into a peptide is the ribosomal peptidyl transferase activity.

quiz.q_zh: flexizyme 在功能上相当于下列哪种蛋白质酶？
quiz.q_en: Which protein enzyme does flexizyme functionally replace?

options.zh: RNA聚合酶（RNA pol）
options.en: RNA polymerase (RNA pol)

options.zh: 氨酰tRNA合成酶（aaRS）
options.en: Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase (aaRS)

options.zh: 核糖核酸酶（RNase）
options.en: Ribonuclease (RNase)

options.zh: 肽基转移酶（transferase）
options.en: Peptidyl transferase (transferase)

quiz.explain_zh: 上载氨基酸到 tRNA 正是 aaRS 的工作。RNase 降解 RNA，肽基转移酶形成肽键，RNA 聚合酶合成 RNA 链，都不是把氨基酸接到 tRNA 上。
quiz.explain_en: Charging a tRNA with an amino acid is precisely the aaRS job. RNase degrades RNA, peptidyl transferase forms peptide bonds, and RNA polymerase synthesises RNA chains; none of them loads an amino acid onto a tRNA.

quiz.q_zh: 镜像生命研究中的“镜像 tRNA”指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In mirror-image life research, what is a 'mirror-image tRNA'?

options.zh: 指tRNA折叠成L形，与手性无关
options.en: A tRNA folded into an L shape, not chirality

options.zh: 指携带D型氨基酸的天然tRNA
options.en: A natural tRNA carrying D-amino acids

options.zh: 由L型核糖构成，是天然D型的镜像
options.en: Made of L-ribose, the mirror of the natural D form

options.zh: 由D型核糖构成，是天然L型的镜像
options.en: Made of D-ribose, the mirror of the natural L form

quiz.explain_zh: 天然 RNA 用 D-核糖，镜像体系用 L-核糖，因此“天然是L型、镜像是D型”把手性说反了。“折叠成L形”混淆的是 tRNA 的三级结构形状；“天然tRNA携带D型氨基酸”与实际相反，天然体系用 L-氨基酸。
quiz.explain_en: Natural RNA uses D-ribose and the mirror system uses L-ribose, so calling the natural form L and the mirror D inverts the chirality. The L-shaped-fold choice confuses tertiary structure with chirality, and a natural tRNA carries L-amino acids, not D.

title_zh: 单纯酶与结合酶：酶蛋白（apoenzyme）+ 辅因子（cofactor）
title_en: Simple and conjugated enzymes: apoenzyme plus cofactor

points.zh: 回到酶的正题：经典生化最喜欢分类，蛋白质类的酶按化学组成分成两大类。
points.en: Back to enzymes proper: classical biochemistry loves classification, and protein enzymes are split by chemical composition into two classes.

points.zh: 单纯酶（simple enzyme）：整个分子就是一个蛋白质，自己就能发挥酶活，不需要任何额外成分。
points.en: Simple enzymes: the whole molecule is just a protein, and it shows catalytic activity on its own with no extra component.

points.zh: 单纯酶里数量最多的是水解酶（hydrolase），例如水解蛋白质的酶，一个蛋白就能完成水解作用。
points.en: The largest group of simple enzymes are hydrolases, for example protein-degrading enzymes, where a single protein does the hydrolysis by itself.

points.zh: 结合酶（conjugated enzyme）：往往带有一些额外的辅助因子（cofactor），要靠它们协助才能表现酶活性。
points.en: Conjugated enzymes carry additional cofactors and need their help to show catalytic activity.

points.zh: 结合酶中的蛋白质部分中文叫“酶蛋白”——注意“酶蛋白”与“蛋白酶”只差字序，含义完全不同，老师也承认这是中文命名的局限。
points.en: The protein part of a conjugated enzyme is called the apoenzyme; in Chinese the term differs from 'protease' only by word order while meaning something entirely different, a limitation of the Chinese naming the lecturer admits.

points.zh: 举例：ATP 酶（ATPase）里非常常见的镁离子 Mg2+ 就是典型的辅助因子。
points.en: Example: the Mg2+ ion, extremely common in ATPases, is a typical cofactor.

points.zh: 考试要抓的只有一句话：有一类结合酶必须依靠辅助因子（cofactor）与蛋白质部分共同作用才有酶活性。
points.en: The one sentence worth memorising: conjugated enzymes require a cofactor working together with the protein part before any activity appears.

extra.zh: 完整的三个名词是：全酶（holoenzyme）= 酶蛋白（apoenzyme）+ 辅因子（cofactor）。单独的 apoenzyme 无活性，单独的 cofactor 也无活性或催化效率极低，只有组装成 holoenzyme 才有活性——这是国内生化考试的标准表述。
extra.en: The complete triad is: holoenzyme = apoenzyme + cofactor. The apoenzyme alone is inactive and the cofactor alone is inactive or nearly so; only the assembled holoenzyme is catalytically active. This is the standard exam formulation.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 老师说“除了镁离子以外的部分叫酶蛋白”，并把它形容成“蛋白酶里的一个亚基”。更准确：酶蛋白（apoenzyme）就是结合酶中整个蛋白质部分，它决定底物专一性和反应类型；辅因子多决定电子／基团传递的种类。apoenzyme 不是“亚基”这一层级的概念。
extra.en: The lecturer says 'everything other than the magnesium ion is the apoenzyme' and calls it 'a subunit inside the enzyme'. More precisely, the apoenzyme is the entire protein portion of a conjugated enzyme; it determines substrate specificity and reaction type, while the cofactor usually determines what electrons or groups are carried. Apoenzyme is not a subunit-level concept.

extra.zh: 辅因子（cofactor）是总称，往下分三类：无机的金属离子（Mg2+、Zn2+、Fe2+/Fe3+、Mn2+）、小分子有机物辅酶（coenzyme）、以及牢固结合的辅基（prosthetic group）。“单纯酶／结合酶”这一分类只适用于蛋白质酶，不适用于核酶。
extra.en: Cofactor is the umbrella term, subdivided into inorganic metal ions (Mg2+, Zn2+, Fe2+/Fe3+, Mn2+), small-organic coenzymes, and tightly bound prosthetic groups. The simple/conjugated split applies to protein enzymes only, not to ribozymes.

quiz.q_zh: 结合酶（conjugated enzyme）由什么组成？
quiz.q_en: What is a conjugated enzyme made of?

options.zh: 酶蛋白与辅因子共同组成
options.en: An apoenzyme plus a cofactor

options.zh: 两个酶蛋白彼此结合而成
options.en: Two apoenzymes bound together

options.zh: 酶蛋白与它的底物结合
options.en: An apoenzyme bound to substrate

options.zh: 两种辅因子彼此结合而成
options.en: Two cofactors bound together

quiz.explain_zh: 结合酶＝酶蛋白＋辅因子，组装起来才是有活性的全酶（holoenzyme）。底物只是被催化的对象，不是酶的组成部分；两个酶蛋白相结合是寡聚酶的情形；辅因子之间结合并不构成酶。
quiz.explain_en: A conjugated enzyme is apoenzyme plus cofactor, and only the assembled holoenzyme is active. A substrate is what gets catalysed, not part of the enzyme; two apoenzymes together describes an oligomeric enzyme; and cofactors bound to one another form no enzyme at all.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项最符合“单纯酶（simple enzyme）”？
quiz.q_en: Which of the following best fits a 'simple enzyme'?

options.zh: 细胞色素，含血红素辅基
options.en: Cytochromes, which carry a haem group

options.zh: 转氨酶，需要磷酸吡哆醛
options.en: Transaminases, which require PLP

options.zh: 多数水解酶，如蛋白水解酶
options.en: Most hydrolases, such as proteases

options.zh: 多数ATP酶，需要镁离子
options.en: Most ATPases, which require Mg2+

quiz.explain_zh: 老师明确指出单纯酶里水解酶最多，一个蛋白就能水解底物。需要镁离子的 ATP 酶、含血红素的细胞色素、需要磷酸吡哆醛的转氨酶都必须带辅因子，属于结合酶。
quiz.explain_en: The lecturer states that hydrolases are the biggest group of simple enzymes: one protein hydrolyses the substrate unaided. ATPases needing Mg2+, haem-containing cytochromes and PLP-dependent transaminases all require cofactors and are conjugated enzymes.

title_zh: 辅因子的种类：金属离子、金属有机物、辅酶与辅基
title_en: Kinds of cofactor: metal ions, metallo-organics, coenzymes and prosthetic groups

points.zh: 辅因子（cofactor）最常见的形式是金属离子（metal ion），例如 ATP 酶中的 Mg2+。
points.en: The commonest form of cofactor is a metal ion, such as the Mg2+ of an ATPase.

points.zh: 辅因子也可以是金属有机化合物，前面讲过的血红素（heme）就是——它不是单纯一个离子，而是金属与有机环形成的复合物。
points.en: A cofactor can also be a metallo-organic compound: haem, met earlier in the course, is not a bare ion but a complex of a metal with an organic ring.

points.zh: 辅酶（coenzyme）与辅基（prosthetic group）在作用上没有区别，都是在起辅因子的作用。
points.en: Coenzyme and prosthetic group do not differ in what they do; both act as cofactors.

points.zh: 两者唯一的区别是与酶蛋白结合的方式：共价结合还是非共价结合。
points.en: Their only difference is how they bind the apoenzyme: covalently or non-covalently.

points.zh: 老师提醒这一小段“文字游戏”多、绕口，考试只要抓住共价／非共价这一条界线即可。
points.en: The lecturer warns this passage is mostly wordplay and convoluted; for the exam, hold on to the covalent versus non-covalent line.

points.zh: 老师给出的 cofactor 与 coenzyme 区分是：cofactor 狭义指蛋白质以外的东西（金属离子等），coenzyme 指主酶以外拼接上来的其他蛋白，并以冠状病毒 RdRp 的 nsp 为例（见 extra 更正）。
points.en: The lecturer's own distinction is that cofactor narrowly means non-protein things such as metal ions, while coenzyme means additional proteins docked onto the main enzyme, illustrated with the nsp components of the coronavirus RdRp. See the extra for the correction.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 老师把 coenzyme 说成“两个蛋白怼到一起”“主酶以外的蛋白亚基，不能叫 cofactor”。这不是标准定义。标准生化：coenzyme 是小分子有机辅因子（NAD+、FAD、CoA、TPP、PLP、生物素、THF 等），多由维生素衍生；cofactor 是包含金属离子、辅酶、辅基在内的上位概念，不是与 coenzyme 并列。辅助的蛋白质亚基应称 accessory／regulatory subunit，例如 SARS-CoV-2 的 nsp12（RdRp 主酶）与 nsp7、nsp8 组成复合体，文献里恰恰把 nsp7/nsp8 称作 protein cofactor——与课上“不能叫 cofactor”正好相反。
extra.en: The lecturer describes a coenzyme as 'two proteins stuck together', an accessory protein subunit that 'cannot be called a cofactor'. That is not the standard definition. In standard biochemistry a coenzyme is a small organic cofactor (NAD+, FAD, CoA, TPP, PLP, biotin, THF), usually vitamin-derived, and cofactor is the superordinate term covering metal ions, coenzymes and prosthetic groups rather than a parallel category. Helper protein subunits are accessory or regulatory subunits; for instance SARS-CoV-2 nsp12 (the RdRp) works with nsp7 and nsp8, which the literature calls protein cofactors, the opposite of what the lecture says.

extra.zh: 经典的操作性区分：辅基与酶蛋白共价或极牢固结合，透析（dialysis）不能除去；辅酶结合疏松，可以透析除去。这就是老一辈生化教材用“可否透析分离”来定义两者的由来。
extra.en: The classical operational test: a prosthetic group is bound covalently or very tightly and cannot be removed by dialysis, whereas a coenzyme binds loosely and dialyses away. That is where the older textbooks' dialysis-based definition comes from.

extra.zh: 典型例子要记牢：辅基——血红素（细胞色素、过氧化氢酶）、FAD（琥珀酸脱氢酶）、生物素（羧化酶，通过赖氨酸共价连接）；辅酶——NAD+/NADP+、CoA、TPP，它们在反应中像共底物（co-substrate）一样往返穿梭于不同的酶之间。
extra.en: Worth memorising: prosthetic groups include haem (cytochromes, catalase), FAD (succinate dehydrogenase) and biotin (carboxylases, covalently linked through a lysine); coenzymes include NAD+/NADP+, CoA and TPP, which shuttle between different enzymes like co-substrates.

quiz.q_zh: 辅酶（coenzyme）与辅基（prosthetic group）的主要区别在于？
quiz.q_en: What mainly distinguishes a coenzyme from a prosthetic group?

options.zh: 发挥作用：一个催化一个支撑
options.en: Role played: catalytic versus structural

options.zh: 分子来源：一个维生素一个糖
options.en: Origin: from vitamins versus from sugars

options.zh: 结合方式：非共价与共价结合
options.en: Binding mode: non-covalent versus covalent

options.zh: 化学本质：一个蛋白一个金属
options.en: Chemical nature: a protein versus a metal ion

quiz.explain_zh: 两者作用相同，界线只在结合是否共价（是否可被透析除去）。说一个是蛋白一个是金属、或一个催化一个只作支撑，都把功能上等同的两者人为割裂；来源上二者都可由维生素衍生，不是糖。
quiz.explain_en: The two do the same job; the line is whether binding is covalent, that is whether dialysis removes it. Calling one a protein and the other a metal, or one catalytic and one merely structural, invents a difference that is not there, and both can derive from vitamins rather than from sugars.

quiz.q_zh: 血红素（heme）作为辅因子属于哪一类？
quiz.q_en: As a cofactor, what kind of molecule is haem?

options.zh: 一条独立的多肽
options.en: A separate polypeptide chain

options.zh: 金属有机化合物
options.en: A metal-organic complex

options.zh: 游离的金属离子
options.en: A free metal ion in solution

options.zh: 一段折叠的RNA
options.en: A folded piece of RNA

quiz.explain_zh: 血红素是铁与卟啉环形成的复合物，既不是裸露的金属离子，也不是多肽或 RNA。老师正是用它说明辅因子不必是单纯的离子。
quiz.explain_en: Haem is a complex of iron with a porphyrin ring, so it is neither a bare metal ion nor a polypeptide nor RNA. The lecturer uses it precisely to show a cofactor need not be a simple ion.

quiz.q_zh: 在标准生物化学中，coenzyme 指的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In standard biochemistry, what is a coenzyme?

options.zh: 小分子有机辅因子，多来自维生素
options.en: A small organic cofactor from a vitamin

options.zh: 与主酶拼接在一起的辅助蛋白亚基
options.en: An accessory protein subunit of the enzyme

options.zh: 只含金属离子的无机辅因子分子
options.en: An inorganic cofactor made of metal ions

options.zh: 能催化反应的一段折叠RNA分子
options.en: A folded RNA that catalyses a reaction

quiz.explain_zh: NAD+、FAD、CoA、TPP、PLP 都是小分子有机物，且多来自 B 族维生素。“辅助蛋白质亚基”是课上的非标准说法，正规名称是 accessory subunit；只含金属离子的是无机辅因子而非辅酶；能自我催化的 RNA 是核酶（ribozyme）。
quiz.explain_en: NAD+, FAD, CoA, TPP and PLP are small organic molecules, mostly derived from B vitamins. The accessory-protein-subunit wording is the lecture's non-standard usage; metal-ion-only species are inorganic cofactors, not coenzymes; and catalytic RNA is a ribozyme.

title_zh: 维生素作为辅酶：VB12（钴胺素）与 VB1
title_en: Vitamins as coenzymes: vitamin B12 (cobalamin) and vitamin B1

points.zh: 维生素常以辅酶的形式存在，是辅酶的前体，老师明确说“我们考试就会考这种东西”。
points.en: Vitamins commonly exist in the form of coenzymes and serve as coenzyme precursors; the lecturer states outright that the exam asks about exactly this.

points.zh: VB12 就是钴胺素（cobalamin），它参与甲基（methyl）的转移。
points.en: Vitamin B12 is cobalamin, and it takes part in the transfer of methyl groups.

points.zh: 因此 VB12 是甲基转移酶（methyltransferase）的辅助因子，老师归类为 cofactor。
points.en: It therefore serves as the cofactor of methyltransferases, which the lecturer classes as a cofactor.

points.zh: 讲义上写明这些维生素“以辅酶的形式存在”，VB1 是其中的例子。
points.en: The slide states that these vitamins exist in coenzyme form, with vitamin B1 as the example.

points.zh: VB1 与 VB12 有点不一样：VB12 是含金属的小分子，VB1 则是一个含嘧啶（pyrimidine）样环的有机小分子。
points.en: Vitamin B1 differs from B12: B12 is a metal-containing small molecule while B1 is a small organic molecule built around a pyrimidine-like ring.

points.zh: 老师提醒讲义里维生素那一整张表内容多、看着吓人，但因为要考，必须背下来。
points.en: The lecturer warns that the vitamin table on the slide is long and daunting, but since it is examined it has to be memorised.

extra.zh: 必背的维生素–辅酶对应表：B1 硫胺素→TPP（焦磷酸硫胺素，α-酮酸脱羧、转酮醇）；B2 核黄素→FMN／FAD（递氢）；B3 烟酸→NAD+／NADP+（递氢）；B5 泛酸→CoA（酰基转移）；B6→PLP 磷酸吡哆醛（转氨、脱羧）；B7 生物素→羧化酶的 CO2 载体；B9 叶酸→THF 四氢叶酸（一碳单位）；B12→甲基钴胺素与腺苷钴胺素。
extra.en: The vitamin-to-coenzyme table to memorise: B1 thiamine gives TPP (thiamine pyrophosphate; alpha-keto acid decarboxylation, transketolase); B2 riboflavin gives FMN/FAD (hydrogen transfer); B3 niacin gives NAD+/NADP+ (hydrogen transfer); B5 pantothenate gives CoA (acyl transfer); B6 gives PLP (transamination, decarboxylation); B7 biotin is the CO2 carrier of carboxylases; B9 folate gives THF (one-carbon units); B12 gives methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上纠结 VB12 该叫 cofactor 还是 coenzyme。按标准定义两者都成立：钴胺素是含钴的小分子有机辅因子，属于 coenzyme，而 coenzyme 本来就是 cofactor 的一个子类。它的两种活性辅酶形式是甲基钴胺素（甲硫氨酸合成酶，甲基转移）和腺苷钴胺素（甲基丙二酰-CoA 变位酶，分子内重排）。
extra.en: The lecture debates whether B12 should be called a cofactor or a coenzyme. Under the standard definitions both hold: cobalamin is a cobalt-containing small organic cofactor, hence a coenzyme, and coenzymes are by definition a subclass of cofactors. Its two active coenzyme forms are methylcobalamin (methionine synthase, methyl transfer) and adenosylcobalamin (methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, intramolecular rearrangement).

extra.zh: VB1（硫胺素 thiamine）不是只有嘧啶环：它由一个氨基嘧啶环和一个噻唑（thiazole）环通过亚甲基桥连接，起催化作用的碳负离子正是在噻唑环上。老师说“有点像嘧啶”只讲了一半。
extra.en: Vitamin B1 (thiamine) is not just a pyrimidine: an aminopyrimidine ring and a thiazole ring are joined by a methylene bridge, and the catalytic carbanion sits on the thiazole ring. The lecturer's 'looks a bit like a pyrimidine' covers only half the molecule.

extra.zh: B 族与 C 是水溶性维生素，几乎都以辅酶／辅酶前体的身份工作，过量随尿排出、不易蓄积；A、D、E、K 是脂溶性维生素，一般不作辅酶（维生素 K 是例外，作为 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子参与凝血因子的 γ-羧化），可在体内蓄积并造成中毒。
extra.en: The B group and vitamin C are water-soluble and act almost entirely as coenzymes or coenzyme precursors, with excess excreted in urine and little accumulation. A, D, E and K are fat-soluble and generally not coenzymes (vitamin K is the exception, a cofactor of gamma-glutamyl carboxylase in clotting-factor carboxylation); they accumulate and can be toxic.

quiz.q_zh: VB12（钴胺素 cobalamin）主要参与哪类基团的转移？
quiz.q_en: Which group transfer does vitamin B12 (cobalamin) mainly serve?

options.zh: 羧基（carboxyl）的转移
options.en: Transfer of carboxyl groups

options.zh: 氨基（amino）的转移
options.en: Transfer of amino groups

options.zh: 磷酸（phosphate）的转移
options.en: Transfer of phosphate groups

options.zh: 甲基（methyl）的转移
options.en: Transfer of methyl groups

quiz.explain_zh: 甲基钴胺素是甲硫氨酸合成酶的辅酶，负责甲基转移。羧基转移由生物素（B7）承担，氨基转移由磷酸吡哆醛（B6）承担，磷酸转移由激酶用 ATP 完成，与 B12 无关。
quiz.explain_en: Methylcobalamin is the coenzyme of methionine synthase and carries methyl groups. Carboxyl transfer belongs to biotin (B7), amino transfer to PLP (B6), and phosphate transfer to kinases using ATP, none of which involves B12.

quiz.q_zh: VB1（硫胺素 thiamine）在体内的活性辅酶形式是？
quiz.q_en: What is the active coenzyme form of vitamin B1 (thiamine) in the body?

options.zh: 焦磷酸硫胺素 TPP
options.en: Thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP)

options.zh: 磷酸吡哆醛 PLP
options.en: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP)

options.zh: 腺苷钴胺素 AdoCbl
options.en: Adenosylcobalamin (AdoCbl)

options.zh: 四氢叶酸 THF
options.en: Tetrahydrofolate (THF)

quiz.explain_zh: 硫胺素磷酸化生成 TPP，是丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶和转酮醇酶的辅酶。磷酸吡哆醛来自 B6，腺苷钴胺素来自 B12，四氢叶酸来自叶酸（B9），都不是 B1 的衍生物。
quiz.explain_en: Thiamine is phosphorylated to TPP, the coenzyme of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and transketolase. Pyridoxal phosphate comes from B6, adenosylcobalamin from B12 and tetrahydrofolate from folate (B9), none of them from B1.

quiz.q_zh: 关于水溶性B族维生素与酶的关系，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about water-soluble B vitamins and enzymes is correct?

options.zh: 多数作为金属离子的替代品
options.en: Most act as substitutes for metal ions

options.zh: 多数作为辅酶或其前体
options.en: Most act as coenzymes or precursors

options.zh: 多数作为酶的催化亚基
options.en: Most act as catalytic subunits of enzymes

options.zh: 多数作为酶的底物被耗尽
options.en: Most are consumed as enzyme substrates

quiz.explain_zh: B 族维生素本身不是蛋白质，因此不可能充当催化亚基；它们在反应中被回收再利用，不像底物那样被净消耗；它们也不替代金属离子，而是与酶蛋白结合形成有活性的全酶。
quiz.explain_en: B vitamins are not proteins, so they cannot be catalytic subunits; they are recycled rather than net-consumed the way substrates are; and they do not stand in for metal ions but bind the apoenzyme to form an active holoenzyme.

title_zh: 酶的分子组成分类：多酶融合体 vs 多功能酶
title_en: Classifying enzymes by molecular organisation: multienzyme assemblies vs multifunctional enzymes

points.zh: 按分子组成，酶可以是单体酶（monomeric）、寡聚酶（oligomeric）或多聚／多酶体系，老师认为这一层分类不重要、不必细看。
points.en: By molecular organisation an enzyme can be monomeric, oligomeric or a multi-subunit/multienzyme system; the lecturer considers this layer unimportant and not worth dwelling on.

points.zh: 真正要分清的是两个概念：多酶融合体和多功能酶（multifunctional enzyme）。
