points.en: What really needs separating are two concepts: the multienzyme assembly and the multifunctional enzyme.

points.zh: 多酶融合体是融合基因（fusion gene）的产物：一条很长的基因转录出 mRNA，再翻译出紧密相连的好几个蛋白，功能上也紧密相连。
points.en: The multienzyme assembly is the product of a fusion gene: one long gene is transcribed into mRNA and translated into several tightly linked proteins whose functions are equally tightly linked.

points.zh: 老师举的最经典例子是乳糖操纵子（lac operon）：几个基因串在一起转录成一条 mRNA、一起翻译出来。
points.en: The lecturer's classic example is the lac operon: several genes strung together are transcribed into one mRNA and translated together.

points.zh: 多功能酶是另一种情况：就是一条多肽链，靠三级结构上不同的区域发挥好几种功能。
points.en: A multifunctional enzyme is the other case: a single polypeptide chain whose different tertiary-structure regions perform several functions.

points.zh: 多功能酶最经典的例子是 DNA polymerase 或 RNA polymerase 的手掌状结构，分为 finger、palm、thumb 三个区域。
points.en: The classic multifunctional enzyme is the hand-shaped fold of DNA or RNA polymerase, divided into fingers, palm and thumb.

points.zh: 两者唯一的区别：一个是好几个蛋白在基因上紧密串联，另一个是一条多肽能发挥好几个功能。
points.en: The single difference: one is several proteins strung tightly together at the gene level, the other is one polypeptide carrying several functions.

points.zh: 酶的命名与分类这一节老师说“一点都不用看”，因为现在很少考（见 extra）；最后一段是腾讯会议共享屏幕显示不全、需要重开会议，无教学内容。
points.en: The lecturer says the section on enzyme naming and classification needs no attention at all because it is rarely examined now (see the extra). The final passage is about the Tencent Meeting screen share cutting off and the meeting being restarted, with no teaching content.

extra.zh: 乳糖操纵子的结构基因是 lacZ、lacY、lacA（β-半乳糖苷酶、乳糖透过酶、硫代半乳糖苷转乙酰酶），不是课上说的“A、C、P”——那大概是把 lacZYA 与 promoter／operator 记混了。更关键：lac operon 转录出的是多顺反子 mRNA（polycistronic mRNA），翻译出三个各自独立的蛋白质，属于共调控的多酶体系，并不是融合基因、也不产生融合蛋白。
extra.en: The structural genes of the lac operon are lacZ, lacY and lacA (beta-galactosidase, lactose permease, thiogalactoside transacetylase), not the 'A, C, P' given in the lecture, which probably mixes lacZYA up with the promoter and operator. More importantly, the lac operon is transcribed as a polycistronic mRNA translated into three separate proteins: a co-regulated multienzyme system, not a fusion gene and not a fusion protein.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 教科书的标准三分法是：单体酶（monomeric）、寡聚酶（oligomeric，多个亚基非共价缔合，如乳酸脱氢酶四聚体）、多酶复合体（multienzyme complex，几种不同的酶非共价聚集成一个机器，典型是丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体：三种酶 E1/E2/E3 加五种辅因子）。多功能酶（又称串联酶 tandem enzyme）的经典例子是动物脂肪酸合成酶 FAS 和嘧啶合成的 CAD 蛋白。
extra.en: The textbook three-way split is: monomeric enzymes; oligomeric enzymes (several subunits associated non-covalently, e.g. the lactate dehydrogenase tetramer); and multienzyme complexes (several different enzymes assembled non-covalently into one machine, the model being the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex with enzymes E1/E2/E3 and five cofactors). Classic multifunctional (tandem) enzymes are animal fatty acid synthase (FAS) and the CAD protein of pyrimidine synthesis.

extra.zh: 老师说命名分类不用看，但国内生化考试常考国际系统分类（EC）的六大类：氧化还原酶（oxidoreductase）、转移酶（transferase）、水解酶（hydrolase）、裂合酶（lyase）、异构酶（isomerase）、连接酶／合成酶（ligase）；2018 年增设第七类转位酶（translocase）。EC 编号为四级，如 EC 2.7.1.1 己糖激酶——2 表示转移酶，7 表示转移磷酸基，故激酶（kinase）都归在 EC 2.7。
extra.en: The lecturer skips naming and classification, but Chinese biochemistry exams regularly test the six EC classes: oxidoreductases, transferases, hydrolases, lyases, isomerases and ligases (synthetases), with translocases added as a seventh class in 2018. EC numbers have four levels, e.g. EC 2.7.1.1 hexokinase, where 2 is transferase and 7 is phosphate transfer, which is why all kinases fall under EC 2.7.

extra.zh: polymerase 的 finger／palm／thumb 是同一条多肽内的结构域（domain），palm 携带催化位点的两个天冬氨酸、finger 定位进入的核苷酸、thumb 抓住双链产物——这是“一条链多个功能区”的直观例证，与“多个基因产物拼在一起”是完全不同的层级。
extra.en: The fingers, palm and thumb of a polymerase are domains within one polypeptide: the palm holds the two catalytic aspartates, the fingers position the incoming nucleotide, and the thumb grips the duplex product. This illustrates one chain with several functional regions, a completely different level from several gene products assembled together.

quiz.q_zh: 多功能酶（multifunctional enzyme）的特征是什么？
quiz.q_en: What characterises a multifunctional enzyme?

options.zh: 一条多肽链上有多个功能域
options.en: One polypeptide with several domains

options.zh: 多条多肽链由融合基因编码
options.en: Several polypeptides from a fusion gene

options.zh: 多个独立蛋白非共价聚集
options.en: Separate proteins held non-covalently

options.zh: 一条多肽链只有一个活性位点
options.en: One polypeptide with one active site

quiz.explain_zh: 多功能酶是一条多肽承担多种催化功能，polymerase 的 finger／palm／thumb 是范例。融合基因编码多条多肽、以及多个独立蛋白非共价聚集，描述的都是多酶体系；只有一个活性位点的单肽链则是普通的单体酶。
quiz.explain_en: A multifunctional enzyme is one polypeptide carrying several catalytic functions, the polymerase fingers/palm/thumb being the model. Several polypeptides from a fusion gene, and separate proteins held non-covalently, both describe multienzyme systems, while a single-active-site chain is just an ordinary monomeric enzyme.

quiz.q_zh: 课上举的 finger／palm／thumb 手掌状结构属于哪种酶？
quiz.q_en: The hand-shaped fingers/palm/thumb architecture cited in the lecture belongs to which enzyme?

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 PDH
options.en: The pyruvate dehydrogenase complex

options.zh: DNA 或 RNA 聚合酶
options.en: DNA or RNA polymerase

options.zh: 乳糖操纵子的半乳糖苷酶
options.en: The lac operon galactosidase

options.zh: 氨酰tRNA合成酶 aaRS
options.en: Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase (aaRS)

quiz.explain_zh: 手掌状的三级结构是核酸聚合酶的标志性折叠，老师用它说明多功能酶。半乳糖苷酶是操纵子里的独立蛋白，aaRS 有自己的催化与反密码子结合域，丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体则是多种酶的非共价聚集体。
quiz.explain_en: The hand-shaped tertiary fold is the signature architecture of nucleic-acid polymerases, and the lecturer uses it to illustrate multifunctional enzymes. Galactosidase is a standalone operon protein, aaRS has its own catalytic and anticodon-binding domains, and the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex is a non-covalent assembly of several enzymes.

quiz.q_zh: 乳糖操纵子（lac operon）转录出的 mRNA 有什么特点？
quiz.q_en: What is true of the mRNA transcribed from the lac operon?

options.zh: 三条独立mRNA，各翻译一个蛋白
options.en: Three separate mRNAs, one protein each

options.zh: 一条前体mRNA，翻译后再剪接
options.en: One precursor mRNA, spliced after translation

options.zh: 多顺反子mRNA，翻译出多个蛋白
options.en: One polycistronic mRNA, several proteins

options.zh: 单顺反子mRNA，翻译出融合蛋白
options.en: One monocistronic mRNA, a fusion protein

quiz.explain_zh: lacZ、lacY、lacA 共用一个启动子转录成一条多顺反子 mRNA，每个顺反子有自己的起始密码与核糖体结合位点，翻译出三个独立蛋白，而不是一个融合蛋白。三条独立 mRNA 违背操纵子的定义；“翻译后剪接”既不存在这种机制，原核也没有内含子剪接。
quiz.explain_en: lacZ, lacY and lacA share one promoter and are transcribed as a single polycistronic mRNA, each cistron having its own start codon and ribosome-binding site, giving three separate proteins rather than one fusion protein. Three independent mRNAs would contradict the definition of an operon, and splicing after translation is not a mechanism at all, prokaryotes having no intron splicing here.
